articleTitle: Research on Double Time-Scale Optimal Scheduling Strategy for Distributed Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the global energy transition, the rapid development of renewable energy is reshaping the energy landscape. However, the inherent intermittency and uncertainty of renewable energy sources such as wind and solar pose significant challenges to the stable operation of power systems. This paper establishes an operational model for micro grids with distributed energy storage and introduces a double time-scale optimal scheduling framework that combines day-ahead and intra-day scheduling, optimized using the Football Team Training Algorithm and the CPLEX solver. A typical microgrid in a park in southern China is used as a case study to verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheduling strategy. The results show that, compared to single time-scale scheduling, the double time-scale scheduling achieves efficient utilization of distributed energy storage, significantly reduces system operating costs, avoids wind and solar curtailment, and improves the utilization rate of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling strategy based on honeycomb distribution network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: China is the country with the largest scale and fastest growing renewable energy in the world. At present, the control strategy of power system is becoming more and more complex, and the problems of reliability and economy are prominent, and new challenges are faced. Inspired by the concept of microgrid group, this paper introduces a new distribution network structure, the honeycomb active distribution network. Firstly, the topology is introduced, and the microgrid and intelligent energy/information exchange base station with the standard configuration of “source, network, load and storage” are analyzed and explained, and the structure and function of the honeycomb active distribution network are introduced. Analyze the power balance and stability under normal working conditions; Then, combined with the mathematical model of the distribution network, the control strategy of the honeycomb active distribution network is elaborated in detail. Finally, a simulation model was built to verify the control strategy.

articleTitle: Massive Data-Driven Joint Characterization Model for Multi-Dimensional Cluster Characteristics of Energy Storage Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: New energy storage cluster consists of a large number of energy storages with various types. The operational parameters of different clusters are significantly differentiated, which makes it difficult to analyze the multi-dimensional characteristics directly and quantitatively. Therefore, characteristics of energy storage clusters are unavailable for the dispatching side, which affects the accurate and effective regulation and control of energy storage resources to a certain extent. In order to make multiple types of energy storage power stations participate in power system dispatching better, it is necessary to mine their characteristics from massive data. This paper proposes a joint characterization model for multi-dimensional characteristics of energy storage power stations. Firstly, this method detects and corrects anomalies in heterogeneous measurement data from multiple sources based on the random forest technique. Secondly, the massive data are divided into measurement priorities according to data types and periods, and mapped to sampling frequencies. Moreover, the models of indices are accurately estimated through stratified sampling and plurality regression. Finally, a multi-dimensional model of energy storage power station characterized by multi-dimensional triplets is constructed and implemented on real energy storage power stations.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Self-Healing Method of Distribution Network Based on SOP and Distributed Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the background of ‘double carbon’, large-scale distributed power supply is added, and the operation mode is becoming more and more complex, which greatly increases the difficulty of self-healing control. Because SOP has the ability to implement power flow control, according to the distributed power supply and SOP access distribution network as the research background, the distributed protection of a new distribution network with SOP is studied, and the fault isolation and self-healing scheme based on multi-terminal information is given. Combined with the 10kV distribution network, the application analysis of the self-healing scheme is carried out. The results show that the scheme can effectively realize the fault self-healing of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Dual Layer Economic Dispatch Strategy for Transmission and Distribution Coordination Based on Analytical Target Cascade Method
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High penetration photovoltaics may cause problems such as voltage exceeding the limit of the distribution network, while the transmission network can provide a certain amount of power to the distribution network. Therefore, this article proposes a dual layer economic dispatch model for transmission and distribution coordination based on the objective cascade method. Firstly, we analyzed the mechanism of coordinated operation of transmission and distribution power grids. And we proposed a hierarchical model for transmission and distribution coordination based on this. Then considering the constraints of power flow and voltage in the transmission and distribution grid, the objective function and constraints of the dual layer economic dispatch model for transmission and distribution coordination were constructed using the objective cascade method and solved using the second-order cone relaxation algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method were verified using the T6D1 node system while the power transmission characteristics of the transmission and distribution network and the output characteristics of the photovoltaic storage load under the coordination of transmission and distribution were analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Service Performance of Engineering Enterprises for non-Interruption work of Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to carry out evaluation on the service performance of engineering enterprises for non-interruption work of distribution network s. Firstly the evaluation system of the service performance of non-interruption work of distribution network was established by introducing the hierarchical analysis method from five aspects, namely, safety factors, system factors, economic factors, personnel factors, and evaluation of work apparatus and equipment. Through the hierarchical analysis method, the evaluation system is constructed by analysing the weights of each factor. The weights of each factor and specific index data will be integrated to attain the comprehensive evaluation results of the service performance of non-interruption work of distribution network of engineering enterprises. Finally, results may provide theoretical and practical guidance for improving the service performance of non-interruption work of distribution network of engineering enterprises.

articleTitle: Distributed Collaborative Regulation Method of Comprehensive Energy System Based on Blockchain and State Awareness
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a distributed database technology, blockchain technology has great development prospects in comprehensive energy systems. In this paper, an energy storage sharing transaction method of integrated energy system based on blockchain and state awareness is proposed. Firstly, the shared transaction mechanism of separation of ownership and use right of energy storage in integrated energy system supported by blockchain is studied, including shared transaction process, price mechanism and scenario, and a shared transaction model of coupling charging right and discharging right of energy storage is established. Secondly, considering various constraints in the integrated energy system, a complete energy storage sharing transaction and control process is formed through real-time state perception, trading function of distributed energy and energy storage; Finally, through the analysis of an example, the shared transaction of energy storage can achieve a win-win situation for both parties.

articleTitle: Research on Smooth Switching Method of PMSG Control Strategies between Grid Following Control and Grid Forming Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The grid forming permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) based on virtual synchronous generator control (VSG) faces complex working requirements, and the grid side inverter often needs to change the control strategy according to the operating conditions. These switching processes are often accompanied by voltage and frequency fluctuations, posing a challenge to the stability of the system. This paper proposes a novel smooth switching strategy of PMSG grid forming converter for the transition between different grid connected modes. This strategy proposes a switching method that includes a self closing loop to regulate the dq axis reference currents, in order to maintain the stability of the reference currents at the moment of switching. Finally, based on the RTLAB and RTU-BOX, a hardware in the loop experimental testing platform was built to verify that the proposed control strategy can achieve smooth switching of grid forming converters in different operating and control modes.

articleTitle: A Fault Identification Method of Generator Excitation System Based on DNA Chain and Two-stage LD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A fault identification method of excitation system based on DNA chain and two-stage Levenshtein Distance (LD) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the identification number, unit information and operating waveform of the power generator are put into the DNA chain, and the time-frequency characteristics of the waveform are extracted by wavelet transform. In addition, the obtained characteristics are divided into approximation parts to improve the speed of fault identification, and detailed departments to accurately identify the type of fault. Based on multiple simulation tests, the accuracy of fault identification is compared with the common AI recognition accuracy rate, which verifies the feasibility of this fault identification method.

articleTitle: An AI Combined with Mathematical Analysis Energy Management System for Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, a notable breakthrough has been made in artificial intelligence (AI) as well as smart grid. Even though it is exciting to see more and more AI-based industrial applications, the big concern of its reliability and interoperability has not been well addressed, especially for critical systems such as the power grid. Therefore, an AI combined with a mathematical analysis method is proposed for active distribution system (ADS) management. First, the classic deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method is applied to realize the data-driven optimal control. Due to the practice limitation, the purely data-driven solution is easily dropped into local optimal points. Thus, the auxiliary mathematical analysis is added to solve this problem. The proposed control method is tested on a typical ADS. The methodology of this work can be generalized into other application systems to overcome the black-box characteristics of deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Broadband Measurement and Resonant Detection Technology of Power System Based on new Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the new energy generation gradually becoming the main power supply, the power system presents broadband characteristics, the difficulty of energy measurement is increased, and the accuracy of harmonic detection is decreased. This paper proposes a broadband measurement and resonance detection technology for a power system based on a new type of sensor. Firstly, the broadband measurement algorithm of the electronic watt-hour meter is designed, and the measurement data can be obtained directly according to the extracted information to improve the accuracy and reliability of measurement. Secondly, the causes of harmonic harmonics in the new power system are analyzed. The real-time amplitude and frequency are detected by the Hilbert transform algorithm, and the harmonic distortion rate and amplitude oscillation are used to judge the resonant frequency. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation based on measured sensor data.

articleTitle: PV- VSG Power Optimizer for Urban Buildings with Improved Flexible Power Point Tracking Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power optimizer is a highly promising structure for photovoltaic (PV) power generation. More solar energy will integrate into the grid through power optimizers because of their low cost and high efficiency. The substantial integration of renewable energy into the grid can reduce grid inertia. To provide enough inertia, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control is introduced to power optimizers. This combination allows power optimizers, which are highly economical and efficient, to have frequency support ability. This paper proposes a novel PV-VSG power generation system based on power optimizer structure, using Flexible Power Point Tracking (FPPT) to enable it to maintain reserve capacity during operation. Buildings in cities are suitable for this system, which is not equipped with energy storage The simulation results verify the system's tolerance to partial shading and frequency support ability.

articleTitle: Real-Time Distribution Network Topology Identification Algorithm Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The accurate, real-time identification of distribution network topology is of critical importance to the stability and efficiency of modern power systems, particularly in light of the integration of renewable energy sources. The traditional methods that are based on pre-annotated data and manual processes are inadequate for real-time applications due to their slow processing times and inability to adapt to dynamic changes. This paper presents a novel algorithm that leverages Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) to overcome the aforementioned limitations. By employing advanced data classification and optimization techniques, the FPGA-based implementation offers considerable improvements in processing speed and accuracy. Experimental evaluations on standard distribution systems have demonstrated superior performance in real-time topology identification compared to traditional methods. This innovative solution provides the basis for managing the safe and stable operation of modern power systems, ensuring power supply reliability and enhancing emergency response capabilities.

articleTitle: Reactive Power and Voltage Co-Control Technology to Control Over-Voltage Problem of Distribution Network Caused by Grid-Connected Distributed Photovoltaic Project
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the over-voltage of 10 kv bus, line and distribution transformer in substation caused by photovoltaic power backward after a large number of distributed PV access, we independently develop reactive power-voltage control equipment, actively monitor and cooperate control, at the same time, the voltage of the distribution network should be adjusted to meet the requirements of the national supply voltage standards to reduce the impact of distributed photovoltaic access on the grid, to achieve the distributed photovoltaic project grid and distribution network voltage management organic coordination.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Identification Based on CNN and Improved Conformal Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: New power system state changes frequently, which needs identifying the possible operating state of the distribution network accurately and quickly. However, the accuracy of the topology recognition using machine learning method is difficult to reach 100%. Therefore, a method of distribution network topology identification based on CNN and improved conformal prediction is proposed in this paper. It gives a variety of possible alternative topologies and their probabilities. Based on multi-mapping relationship between the switching state of the distribution network and measured voltage data, this paper uses CNN to build a multi-output classifier. Improved conformal prediction method is used to integrate and output the possible operating topologies. The IEEE-33-node distribution network is used for verify the proposed method. The simulation experimental results indicate that this model would achieve a high accuracy of topology identification when the average number of outputs is small.

articleTitle: Strategic Bidding for Wind-PV-Storage Power Station Clusters Participating in Day-ahead Energy Market Based on Conditional Value at Risk Under Dual Settlement Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays, it is inevitable for renewable energy power stations to participate in market-oriented competition. In this paper, a strategic bidding model based on conditional value at risk (CVaR) and dual settlement mode (DSM) for wind-photovoltaic-energy storage power station clusters (WSSC) participating in the day-ahead energy market is expounded. To begin with, a new reporting method that adding the power of ESS to the bidding quantity of renewable energy is proposed. Then, considering CVaR and DSM simultaneously, a scenario-based strategic bidding model is put forward. In the end, case studies indicate the significance of energy storage system (ESS) in arbitrage, minimizing deviation assessment punishment and power curtailment punishment. Besides, decision maker can choose suitable risk weight factor according to their own degree of risk preference to make a perfect balance between profit and risk. Apart from that, numerical results also validate that bidding as a whole for WSSC owns more advantages than bidding independently over bid-winning quantity, profit and CVaR.

articleTitle: Real Time Digital Simulation and Analysis of Mineral Arc Furnace Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Firstly, the equivalent electrical circuit of the mineral arc furnace is introduced in the actual project, including the furnace, short network, furnace transformer, reactive power compensation, and so on. According to the practical parameters and application conditions, a simulation model is built on the real-time digital simulation (RTDS) device. By comparing and analyzing the current, voltage, U-I curve, power characteristic and other contents of the mineral arc furnace system, the correctness of the RTDS simulation model is verified, and the model can be used in the pre-installation simulation of the project.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of User-Side Energy Storage Aggregation Based on Cooperative Alliance
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to cope with the increasing integration of renewable energy into the power system, a significant number of distributed user-side energy storage systems (ESS) have been deployed to enhance the flexibility of the distribution system. However, these ESSs face challenges such as limited individual capacities that fall below the market access threshold and declining returns due to the presence of disorderly competition. To address the aforementioned issues, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling strategy of user-side energy storage aggregation (ESA) based on cooperative alliance. By aggregating small-capacity ESSs, ESA can participate in more market services, while the cooperative alliance framework can effectively unify the decision-making goals within the ESA. A case study is conducted with three user-side ESSs in a distribution network in Zhejiang. The results indicate that the proposed ESA optimal scheduling strategy markedly enhances the revenue-generating capacity of user-side ESS while circumventing the economic losses associated with disorderly competition among ESS individuals.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of Real-Time Ampacity of High Voltage Power Cable Duct Laying Based on Environmental Information
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to fully utilize the current-carrying capacity of power cables, it is demanding to accurately calculate cables real-time ampacity. In this point of view, a real-time ampacity calculation methodology based on environmental information is proposed. Firstly, a coupled multi-physics cable model is constructed. Secondly, the real-time environmental information is obtained based on a thermocouple and a distributed optical fiber temperature measurement system (DTS). Based on these, the real-time ampacity of cables is calculated by Newton method. The numerical results on a case study indicate that the real-time ampacity calculated by using the proposed methodology is approximately 39.08% higher as compared to the nominal ampacity.

articleTitle: Research on Overvoltage Suppression Based on DC Circuit Breaker(CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper., the topology of DC circuit breaker is proposed., when the fault current occurs., the sampling circuit detects that the current exceeds the threshold., and immediately starts the driving power supply to quickly shut down the JFET., but the JFET is susceptible to the influence of line parasitic inductance in the process of fault current removal., and then there is a serious overvoltage problem., the overvoltage suppression circuit is proposed., its working principle is analyzed in detail and the circuit parameters are designed., and finally., the circuit breaker prototype is developed and experimentally verified. The results show that the circuit breaker has good rapidity and overvoltage suppression effect.

articleTitle: Effect of Tensile Stress on Insulation Properties of 500 kV EHVAC XLPE Cable Under Multi-Field Ageing
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using submarine cables to connect offshore wind farms and oil drilling platforms for power transmission and distribution has become the optimal choice for offshore energy projects. Studying the impact of complex laying environments during the actual operation of extra-high voltage AC (EHVAC) cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) submarine cables has become imminent. This study investigates the impact of multi-field ageing on the insulation properties of 500 kV EHVAC submarine cables. The ring-cut samples with a thickness of 0.15 mm are aged at a fixed temperature of 110°C and electric field of 20 kV/mm, while being subjected to varying tensile stresses from 30 N up to 80 N. The aged XLPE samples are analyzed through crystalline analysis, dielectric properties and AC breakdown measurements at 30°C and 70 °C. The results suggest that as tensile stress increases, aged samples exhibit a notable reduction in crystallinity and AC breakdown strength, alongside an improvement in the dielectric constant. It concludes that stretching the XLPE samples leads to molecular chain breakage, resulting in an increase in defects between lattices and amorphous regions, consequently making the polarization easier to establish. Also, the increase of the tensile stress will accelerate the degradation of the insulation layer of the 500 kV EHVAC submarine cables.

articleTitle: Reflections on the Upgrading of Distribution Network Induced by a Hierarchical Tripping Accident
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of cities, cable equipment has been extensively utilized in distribution networks, and the compensation capacity of arc suppression coils in 10 kV distribution networks has gradually become insufficient to meet the compensation demands. Neutral grounding through the low resistor is a common solution to solve the problem in some regions. Along with the change in neutral grounding, the corresponding relay protection should also be adjusted accordingly. However, due to the complexity of the distribution network structure, a single adjustment in protection often fails to fully satisfy the coordination requirements between superior and subordinate protections. This paper begins with a typical hierarchical tripping accident, analyzes the causes of such accidents under this distribution network, and proposes corresponding measures to prevent hierarchical tripping accidents and to optimize this network structure. It offers feasible suggestions for the construction of a new type of power system, thereby effectively enhancing the reliability of power supply in distribution networks.

articleTitle: Operation and Maintenance Method in Electric Data Acquisition System Based on Topology Identification and Intelligent Meter Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electric data acquisition system composed of massive meters is the underlying foundation for the perception of the operating environment of the novel power system, and acquisition system's operational efficiency directly affects the operational efficiency of the novel power system. At present, the electric data acquisition system encounters two major problems, namely the poor communication effect between the low-voltage substation concentrator and the meter, and the difficulty in intelligent meter operation and maintenance localization. Therefore, this article proposes an operation and maintenance method in electric data acquisition system based on topology identification and intelligent meter localization. This article designs experiments based on advanced measurement infrastructure (AMI) to verify the proposed method. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively solve the two major problems in the operation and maintenance of the electric data acquisition system.

articleTitle: Design of One New Low-Cost Flexible Interconnection of Distribution Grids and Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using flexible interconnection devices to transform the distribution network can achieve efficient interaction among generation, network, load, and storage, addressing the issues of load imbalance and power quality caused by the large-scale integration of distributed energy sources. This paper summarizes the circuit topology and control technology of flexible interconnection for distribution grids. A comparative analysis of circuit topologies for flexible interconnection in distribution grids was conducted, proposing a novel series-type flexible interconnection. The study includes an analysis of the topology structure and control principles, and describes the corresponding valve control system and drive modules. Finally, prospects for the development trend of flexible interconnection technologies in medium-voltage distribution networks were provided..

articleTitle: Analysis of Single-phase Ground Fault Characteristics of Low-resistance Grounding Distribution Network with Inverter-interfaced Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The single-phase ground fault characteristics of the low-resistance grounding distribution network will change due to the integration of distributed generation (DG), which will have a series of impacts on the applicability of original relay protection principles and configuration of devices in the distribution network. This paper first establishes an equivalent model of single-phase ground fault, and then analyzes the ground fault of low-resistance grounding distribution network containing inverter-interfaced DG (IIDG), and summarizes the impact of IIDG access on the fault electrical quantity. Finally, a 10kV low-resistance grounding distribution network simulation experiment model containing IIDG is constructed using MATLAB/Simulink to verify the accuracy of theoretical analysis of fault characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Load Modeling Method of Oilfield Distribution Network with Distributed Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the condition of high proportion of distributed photovoltaic and energy storage devices connected to the oilfield power grid, there is a lack of load modeling method that can reflect the impact of new energy integration. This limitation hinders the safe and stable operation of the oilfield power grid. This paper proposes a comprehensive load modeling method for oilfield distribution networks with distributed power sources. The static and dynamic characteristics of generalized loads such as distributed photovoltaic, energy storage battery and pumping unit in oilfield are analyzed, and the comprehensive load model of oilfield distribution network is established. Sensitivity analysis of parameters is conducted to identify key parameters, followed by parameter identification using particle swarm optimization algorithms. Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of the comprehensive load modeling method proposed in this paper are verified by simulation and engineering examples.

articleTitle: Assessment of Carrying Capacity and Optimized Operation Methods for Distributed Photovoltaic and Wind Power in Rural Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As clean energy gains popularity, integrating distributed photovoltaic and wind power into rural distribution networks poses challenges to their stability. This study evaluates the carrying capacity of these networks and explores operational strategy optimization to enhance their efficiency and capacity. Using mathematical modeling and simulation, the research proposes customized strategies based on real conditions to maximize clean energy use while maintaining network stability. The findings indicate that effective optimization can significantly improve the network's carrying capacity, supporting more sustainable and efficient rural power development.

articleTitle: Aggregation Quantitative Model of County Characteristic Load Based on Adjustable Potential Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When compared to urban industrial and commercial loads, county-level characteristic loads exhibit a wide variety and are dispersed across both time and space. This dispersion makes it challenging to establish a natural matching relationship between the power consumption characteristics of county-level loads and the output characteristics of distributed photovoltaic power generation. Existing methods have struggled to address the quantification of flexibility aggregation within county characteristic loads. In this paper, we achieve electricity pattern recognition and adjustable potential evaluation of county loads through the use of an adjustable potential model. Furthermore, we establish a quantitative model for county load aggregation based on sequence operation theory, which effectively extracts adjustable potential indices for load aggregation, such as those for individual users, low-voltage feeders, and distribution station areas. Verification of the proposed model's efficacy is demonstrated by the example analysis results.

articleTitle: Multi-Type Electric Vehicle Schedulability Modeling Method based on User Charging Behavior Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid proliferation of Electric Vehicles (EV s), effectively leveraging the regulation potential of EV charging loads has become a prominent issue. This paper proposes a multi-type EV schedulability modeling method based on the analysis of charging behavior characteristics of different user types. The model comprehensively considers the charging characteristics of various types of EV s, including private cars, ride-hailing vehicles, and taxis, utilizing a charging start-stop probability distribution model. Case studies demonstrate that this model can not only accurately reflect the charging demands of EV s but also provide valuable references for strategies involving EV fleet participation in grid regulation.

articleTitle: Conceptual Design to the Power System of Lunar Research Station
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electricity plays a pivotal role in operating diverse scientific research, thermal control, and life support systems on the lunar surface. Recognizing the crucial role of electricity in the Lunar Research Station (LRS), it becomes imperative to propose a power system that ensures high reliability and efficiency. Drawing upon insights and experiences from previous space activities, the paper presents a systematic solution for the power system of the LRS, contextualized within the complexities of the lunar surface environment. The proposed systematic approach considers constraints related to volume and weight, technological maturity, scalability, and the lunar surface environment. The paper meticulously explores the power system structure, multidimensional power generation technology, power transmission technology, and power management strategy, providing a practical implementation path for constructing the power system for an LRS.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Arc Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Photovoltaic power stations are prone to arc faults due to wind, sun, resulting in frequent occurrence of photovoltaic fires and economic losses to the photovoltaic. As a result, it is crucial to identify arc defects in solar power plants in order to guarantee their dependability and efficiency. This research proposes a multi-group string comparison method for photovoltaic fault detection. The photovoltaic system's arc fault model is established, the arc fault characteristics are obtained, and the characteristic quantities are extracted. the arc diagnosis model of photovoltaic power station is established, which can effectively identify series fault and parallel arc fault based on particle swarm optimization random forestrc. Its accuracy is higher than that of random forest recognition, the anti-interference of the diagnosis model is analyzed by the actual power station operation data. It is verified that the model is not interfered by the inverter Internal mechanisms and environmental factors.

articleTitle: Study on Start-up and Operation Characteristics of Lava Tower Photothermal Power Station in Large-Scale New Energy Base
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Photothermal power generation is a kind of grid-friendly new energy generation form. Because of its energy storage function, it plays a very good role in translating new energy fluctuations. Based on the data of the tower lava photothermal generator set in actual operation, this paper studies and analyzes the start-up characteristics of the photothermal generator set and the power generation characteristics of the photothermal generator set in different weather conditions, and provides technical reference for the safe and stable operation of the high-proportion new energy grid.

Author Keywords: start-up characteristics of photo-thermal power generation

articleTitle: Calculation and Test Methods for Ice-Shedding Jump of Wire
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wire ice-shedding jump is a form of movement in which the wire tension is suddenly released and the wire bends elastically. The paper based on the principle of elastic deformation and conservation of energy, the analysis, calculation and simulation test methods of wire ice-shedding jump are established, forming a direct and comprehensive application technology of wire ice-shedding jump, and controlling the amplitude and maximum value of dynamic tension of wire ice-shedding jump.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Method of Quality Competitiveness of Power Equipment Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the application of quality competitiveness index system of electrical equipment industry, this paper establishes a multi-level quality competitiveness index system of electrical equipment industry, uses the improved Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to calculate the index weights of all levels, analyzes the application of quality competitiveness evaluation model to the bid winning suppliers for electrical equipment of State Grid, and provides information on the current situation and reliability of power equipment suppliers' quality development, helping improve the quality level of equipment in power industry.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning of the Power Distribution System Inspection VQA Model Based on Box Annotation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large Models (LMs) have achieved excellent results in general domains, and their application in vertical domains has been a research hotspot. This paper attempts to convert box annotations to Visual Question Answering (VQA) labels for LM's fine-tuning in the distribution inspection domain. The proposed approach can effectively utilize the cheap and easily accessible box annotations, predefined question templates, power equipment Knowledge Graph (KG), and randomization method for VQA label generation. This paper chose the BLIP model for fine-tuning and evaluation, and the results show that the BLIP can understand the content of distribution inspection images better and generalization in multiple questions. However, this paper also points out that the application of the LM in the field of inspection may still have problems such as poor cost-effectiveness and loss of generalization ability.

articleTitle: Revenue Estimation for Vehicle-to-Grid with Household Behind-the-Meter Solar and Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As electric vehicles (EVs) become increasingly prevalent, Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G), as a flexible means of interaction between EVs and the power grid, has attracted considerable attention, yet its commercial prospects remain unclear. In this paper, a V2G revenue estimation method is proposed for households with behind-the-meter solar and storage. Firstly, a mathematical model consists of solar, storage, and EVs is established, with a rolling optimization method is proposed to solve the mathematical model. Secondly, typical EV usage scenarios in household areas are analyzed based on diverse travel demand. Finally, through empirical case studies, the efficacy and viability of the proposed method are validated. The research findings suggest that V2G holds potential economic benefits within household areas, thereby offering new insights into future vehicle grid interaction and household energy management.

articleTitle: Stratified Economic Dispatching Strategy for Microgrids Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The boundaries between the source and load sides of the distribution network are becoming increasingly blurred, and the matching of power supply and demand is becoming increasingly difficult. Promoting demand response will be an inevitable requirement for building a new type of power system. This article divides the microgrid scheduling strategy into instruction layer, coordination layer, and execution layer based on the entities and stages involved in demand response process. The instruction layer strategy is oriented towards microgrid operation managers, with the consideration of system operation safety; The coordination layer strategy is oriented towards resource agents, which maximizing economic benefits while responding to the instruction layer; The execution layer strategy assigns response tasks to terminal control objects. The above microgrid operation strategy was validated using a typical community level household microgrid scenario, and the simulation results showed the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A Model for Economic and Environmental-Friendly Load Control in Commercial Parks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of a new electricity system, balancing supply and demand is critical, and commercial parks with large adjustable loads offer an effective solution. This study proposes establishing an Energy Hub (EH) architecture in commercial parks to integrate natural gas power generation, photovoltaic and wind power generation, surplus electricity grid connection, and various energy-consuming devices. This architecture incorporates energy storage to manage the uncertain output of solar and wind power.Retail electricity prices and carbon subsidy prices are utilized to guide commercial parks in demand response. An automatic demand response model for electricity load and carbon emissions is established based on time-of-use electricity prices and carbon quotas. Considering the uncertainty of wind and solar power, an energy optimization operation model is developed to minimize operating costs and environmental impact. This model is simplified and formulated as a mixed-integer linear programming problem, solved using the CPLEX solver.A case study comparing three scenarios demonstrates that the proposed control model effectively reduces electricity costs, coordinates multiple energy sources, meets demand response requirements, reduces carbon emissions, and achieves peak shaving and valley filling for electricity loads.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Scheduling of Multi-Microgrid System with Hydrogen Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of multi-microgrid systems (MMGSs) holds promise for enhancing system reliability and optimizing the utilization of renewable energy resources. Additionally, hydrogen energy storage (HES) offers a viable means of mitigating the inherent fluctuations in renewable energy sources. In order to better realize the energy scheduling across microgrids and cope with renewable energy fluctuations, this study introduces a distributed optimal scheduling for multi-microgrid systems with hydrogen based on model predictive control (MPC). Structured as a two-layer optimization framework, the proposed approach entails an upper layer employing distributed rolling optimization modeling to govern inter-microgrid power transmission and coordination. Concurrently, the lower layer implements a feedback correction model at a shorter time scale, enabling each microgrid to autonomously devise equipment output schemes, thereby facilitating microgrid regulation and leveraging hydrogen energy storage to address renewable energy uncertainty. Finally, empirical validation of the proposed scheme, along with the efficacy of hydrogen energy storage, is demonstrated through a project-based evaluation.

articleTitle: Simulation of Dynamic Radar Echo from Wind Turbine Array Based on 3D Scattering Point Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Simulating the dynamic radar echo from the wind turbine array plays an important role in improving the anti-interference ability of radar. However, the traditional methods can hardly accurately simulate the dynamic radar echo from a wind turbine array composed of more than 4 wind turbines, which cannot meet the requirement. In that case, this paper introduced the 3D scattering point algorithm combined with a new way of considering the electromagnetic coupling effect and realized the simulation from the wind turbine array. Taking the GW 77/1500 wind turbine array as an example, the dynamic radar echoes from 1–8 wind turbines are simulated, in which the radar echo from 2 wind turbines is analyzed and compared with the traditional methods. The results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the accuracy of the simulation by over 7 % more than the scattering point integral algorithm, and the Doppler characteristic is better consistent with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Generic Low-Order Primary Frequency Response Model for Frequency Nadir Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Maintaining the balance between generation and load is critical for power system frequency stability. Large disturbances disrupt this balance and cause frequency deviations from its normal operating value. Primary frequency response (PFR) occurs within the first few seconds, during which the frequency reaches its nadir before returning to a new operating point. The frequency nadir (FN) is a crucial indicator of frequency stability. Accurate FN estimation helps operators assess stability risks and determine necessary PFR resources and frequency regulation reserves. Existing analytical methods face issues such as poor applicability, inability to numerically solve for FN, and unexplored rationale for low-order fitting. This paper proposes a generic low-order PFR model applicable to different governor-turbine systems, enabling efficient numerical calculation of the frequency nadir.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment of Transmission Towers Based on Entropy Weight-Topsis
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low reliability of the weight coefficients of the influencing factors in the existing evaluation method of the transmission tower safety assessment project, an entropy weight method based on the improved entropy weight method is proposed. An evaluation model of transmission tower safety assessment project based on improved reliability entropy weight method is proposed. Using this method, four safety evaluation indexes were established, including the reliability index of the transmission tower, the von Mises stress, the change coefficient of the maximum stress mean and the total displacement strength. By constructing the finite element model of the transmission tower, extracting the values of various safety indicators, and calculating the objective weight of each index and scoring it, an objective safety assessment model was constructed, and the scientific decision-making of the safety assessment project of the transmission tower was realized. The simulation results show that the proposed method can provide theoretical support for the safety assessment engineering of transmission towers.

articleTitle: A Passive Calculation Method for Loop-Closing Current in Distribution Networks Based on Thevenin Theorem
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the operation and planning of active distribution networks, loop-closing operations involve complex current calculations. To avoid introducing additional disturbances to the power system, this paper proposes a passive calculation method for loop-closing current in distribution networks based on Thevenin theorem. Initially, through the system's inherent small disturbances and applying Thevenin theorem, the equivalent impedance and open-circuit voltage of the distribution network are calculated. This process simplifies the complex distribution network into a single-port network model consisting of an independent voltage source in series with an impedance. Subsequently, using this equivalent model and the open-circuit voltages and equivalent impedance at the loop-closing points, the loop-closing current is calculated. Finally, the accuracy of the equivalent impedance and open-circuit voltage calculations is validated through comparisons of different disturbance methods. Loop-closing currents are then computed for various distribution network scenarios, demonstrating that this method, which does not require additional disturbance testing, can accurately calculate loop-closing currents while ensuring system stability. This provides reliable technical support for the safe operation of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Fault Localization of Active Distribution Network based on Improved Seagull Optimization Algorithm: *Note: Sub-titles are not captured in Xplore and should not be used
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To solve the issues of long localization times, low population diversity, slow convergence rates, and weak fault tolerance in the intelligent optimisation algorithms currently in use for fault localization in active distribution networks, a fault localization technique based on an improved seagull optimisation algorithm is put forth. Firstly, enriching the diversity of initialized seagull populations through an improved logistic chaotic mapping; Secondly, linearize the linear parameter H to better match the convergence process; Next, the sine cosine operator is introduced to balance the algorithm between global search and local development, in order to improve the quality of optimization; Then, implement adaptive t-distribution mutation to improve optimization speed. Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by an example simulation.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Distribution Network Data Sensing and Fault Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper introduces a sophisticated system designed for the sensing and analysis of faults within low-voltage distribution networks, specifically tailored for the 0.4kV infrastructure. Anchored by the Smart Transformer Terminal Unit (STTU) framework, the system adeptly meets the operational and inspection management demands while upholding stringent information security protocols. The system is adept at capturing operational parameters and performing real-time fault diagnosis on-site for the facilities it monitors. It ensures that the data gathered is securely sent to the power grid company's Internet of Things (IoT) management platform, leveraging a robust 4G APN communication network to maintain data integrity and confidentiality. Through its practical engineering applications, the system has proven instrumental in the efficient monitoring of low-voltage distribution operations and in the precise analysis of power outage causes.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation of Power Digital Twin Based on Visual Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When the historical data sample is insufficient, it is necessary to use algorithms to expand the data space of the power digital twin system. In this paper, the visual evaluation method based on deep neural network and few-shot learning are integrated to realize the multi-dimensional data augment of data space under the condition of limited historical samples. Firstly, multi-type simulation samples are generated based on Wasserstein GAN. Then the real and simulated samples are mapped to the low-dimensional visualization space by deep auto-code model. Through the evaluation in the visual space, the samples can be verified, and based on the results, the subsequent simulation samples of specific scenes can be generated, and the diversified dimension of data space can be realized. The proposed method was verified by a case study based on the measured data of a real power system.

articleTitle: A Fine-Grained Household Electricity Perception Method Based on Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) is capable to identify detailed electrical appliances by analyzing load data, thereby obtaining a list of appliance energy consumption and visualizing the carbon footprint of the devices. In this context, this paper proposes a fine-grained household electricity perception method based on NILM. To detect load events, the cumulative sum algorithm is employed. To enhance the accuracy of load event identification, the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is introduced to improve the Self-Organizing Map (SOM) neural network by optimizing the initial weights. Furthermore, the depth-first search algorithm is utilized to match load events with the corresponding devices, which improves the speed and depth of the search path for perceiving device electricity consumption behavior. Finally, simulations are carried out, proving the effectiveness of the proposed fine-grained household electricity perception method.

articleTitle: Multi-Core Module Configuration Model Considering “Cloud-Edge-End-Core” Collaborative Efficiency Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by the traditional vertical “cloud-edge-end” structure of intelligent measurement systems, which impedes horizontal information exchange and hampers collaboration efficiency, a novel multi-core module configuration model that optimizes “cloud-edge-end-core” collaborative efficiency is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a “cloud-edge-device-core” collaborative technology framework for intelligent measurement based on InOS operating system is proposed to enhance data interaction flexibility through multi-core modules and peer-to-peer collaboration. Then, an optimization model is constructed with the objective of minimizing the comprehensive cost including chip configuration and data transmission. The model is designed to optimize cooperative efficiency across the “cloud-edge-end-chip”, with decision variables including the core board of intelligent measurement terminals, chips for smart meter management units, and application deployment locations. Finally, a case study on low-voltage topology identification demonstrates the optimized hardware configuration of multi-core modules, showcasing improved efficiency in “cloud-edge-device-core” collaboration in intelligent measurement systems.

articleTitle: Research on Current Balance Control of Off-Grid Inverter with Asymmetric Load
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Off-grid inverters can maintain the current output balance even when the load is asymmetrical, which is very important for the efficient and economical operation of the micro-grid system composed of new energy. In this paper, a single three-phase voltage source inverter with unbalanced load is taken as an example to study the unbalanced mechanism, and a simple and effective current balance control strategy is proposed. Firstly, the current output characteristics of off-grid inverter are analyzed when the load is asymmetric. Then, a negative sequence component extraction method based on SOGI is adopted, and an unbalanced current suppression method is designed on the basis of this extraction method. Finally, the PLECS simulation model is used to verify the results. The results show that this strategy can effectively suppress the output current distortion caused by load asymmetry, and obtain high quality current output waveform.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Reactive Voltage Control in Active Distribution Networks Based on Transformer Based Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the challenges of insufficient data feature extraction, limited model generalization ability, and low computational efficiency in traditional deep learning methods for reactive voltage control (VRC) in active distribution networks (ADN), a Transformer based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) VRC for AND model is proposed. Firstly, the necessity of VRC in active distribution networks based on ADN coordinated control and its optimized operation mode was analyzed. Then, by introducing a transformer into the traditional DRL model, a VRC optimization model based on transformer was designed to effectively improve ADN performance. Finally, a comparative analysis was conducted between the proposed method and three other methods under the same database conditions through numerical examples. The experimental results show that under the same experimental conditions, the proposed method has the smallest root mean square error and the highest correlation coefficient, with the highest degree of data fitting. The minimum value is 0.0289, and the maximum correlation coefficient is 0.996, which meets the requirements of VRC in ADN. Its performance is superior to other comparative methods.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanized Construction Plan for Electrical Installation of 110kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to further implement the overall requirements of the “six perfections and four modernizations” of infrastructure proposed by State Grid Co., LTD., relying on the 110kV Guangxuan power transmission and transformation project to carry out the special design of mechanized construction, the paper studies the innovative scheme of mechanized construction of the main transformer, gas insulated metal closed switchgear, switchgear and secondary screen cabinet of typical substations. It lays the foundation for the comprehensive application of highly mechanized construction, and also provides technical support for low-carbon green construction.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review of Indoor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Inspection Technology and Applications in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power industry and the widespread application of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles), indoor inspection is facing new opportunities and challenge. Ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient UAV inspection in indoor environments such as substations and distribution rooms is crucial. This study, based on the indoor inspection needs of the power industry, provides an overview of indoor inspection UAV types and insulation protection features, reviews four key technical issues (endurance, control, sensing, navigation) of indoor UAV inspection, and explores future development prospects. The aim is to provide useful references for indoor UA V inspection in the power industry and promote the development of smart grids.

articleTitle: Regional Grid High-Temperature Warning Based on Long Short-Term Memory Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: During hot summers, high temperatures significantly increase power demand, especially due to air conditioning usage, posing immense pressure and challenges to the power grid and potentially leading to severe consequences like power supply shortages, voltage instability, and widespread blackouts. This paper introduces a high-temperature warning model for regional power grids utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. By processing and analyzing weather observation data from Hangzhou during the summer of 2023, LSTM, CNN, and ARIMA models were constructed and their temperature prediction performance was compared. The findings indicate that the LSTM surpasses the CNN and ARIMA in performance across six metrics. Notably, the LSTM model also excels in air conditioning load forecasting, demonstrating its potential and accuracy in practical applications.

articleTitle: Robust Planning of Photovoltaic Power Stations Considering Carbon Emission Based on LCA
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To enhance the economic performance of photovoltaic (PV) power stations within microgrids, a capacity planning method for PV power stations is conducted in conjunction with a full lifecycle assessment approach (LCA). Initially, a full lifecycle assessment method that can calculate the carbon emissions per unit PV capacity is proposed, and it is incorporated into the PV planning costs. To address the uncertainty of PV generation, a two-stage robust optimization model (TSROM) is used to optimize the PV capacity. The first stage minimizes the capacity investment costs and carbon emission costs, including the capacities of PV, ES, and diesel generators. The second stage, considering the uncertainty of PV generation, establishes a bi-level model to minimize operational costs under the most adverse conditions of PV generation. The case studies validate the effectiveness of the model and explore the impact of the PV carbon emission factor on PV capacity planning.

articleTitle: Study On Source Load Cooperative Layout Of Active Distribution Network Based On R-Copular (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, we first introduce the Vine Copular model, and then construct a linear optimal allocation model considering network loss and carbon emission. For external grid and internal power output, factors such as electricity prices are incorporated into economic targets. Secondly, in terms of constraint conditions, the DC power flow is considered, and the network loss is included in the constraint conditions of power balance and bus node balance. Finally, the Copular model of wind speed, irradiance and load is constructed based on the Vine Copular model in the calculation example, and the effectiveness of the planning scheme of source load collaborative layout based on Vine copular is analyzed under two application scenarios of historical data missing and historical extreme weather simulation.

articleTitle: Failure Mode Analysis and Identification Method Based on the External Characteristics of DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-voltage DC (HVDC) power transmission, DC circuit breaker (DCCB) has become an ideal DC fault isolation equipment, but it is prone to failure because of the various types and a large number of components in its topology. This paper studies the failure mode of the internal components, summarizes the failure characteristics of DCCB, and proposes a failure identification method based on voltage and current characteristics of DCCB. The simulation results of PSCAD/EMTDC show that the proposed method can effectively distinguish the DCCB internal component failure in real time.

articleTitle: Improving The Delivery Capacity Of Submarine Cable Landing Section By Air And Water Forced Circulation Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In hot weather, the landing section of submarine cable with poor heat dissipation condition is restricting the delivery capacity of submarine cable lines. In this study, a cooling system with cold air forced circulation and water circulation cooling method is designed for the landing section of submarine cable to overcome the limitation of the delivery capacity. The test of the cooling effect of the test cable trench and submarine cable under the action of forced circulating cooling of cold air is carried out. The results show that air forced cooling system can reduce the cable skin temperature more than 10°C in 5 hours, when the condition of ambient temperature of 28°C to 37°C. Water circulation cooling system can keep the water environment temperature stable when the external heat dissipation environment is extremely bad, reduce the influence of the external heat dissipation environment, reduce the cable conductor temperature 30 °C.

articleTitle: Design a Synchronization Method for Parallel Converters Sharing AC Bus and DC Bus (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the carrier asynchronous of parallel converters, this paper designs a fiber-optic carrier synchronization circuit and a carrier synchronization algorithm. The optical fiber signal transmiting and receiving circuit are designed on the converter main control board. The carrier synchronization algorithm of multiple parallel converters employs one master, one backup and multiple slaves. When the master is normal, it sends a synchronization signal and the backup and the slaves receive the carrier synchronization signal to synchronize with it. When the backup detects the failure of the master, the backup sends a synchronization signal, and the master and the slaves receive the synchronization signal to achieve the synchronization of all parallel converter carriers. The experimental results show the feasibility and validity of the fiber-optic carrier synchronization circuit and the carrier synchronization algorithm.

articleTitle: Coordinated Electric Vehicle Charging Control Considering Expected Charge Curve
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the number of electric vehicles (EVs) increasing, uncoordinated charging loads of EVs have placed a great burden on the grid. To address this problem, a large number of studies have focused on the coordinated charging of EVs. However, previous studies usually assume that EVs charge at rated power, which does not always conform with the real case due to multiple uncertainties. By incorporating the expected charge curve (ECC) of EVs, a more precise control of EV charging loads can be achieved. In this context, this paper proposes a coordinated EV charging control strategy considering ECC in residential areas. Firstly, a charging load control framework utilizing smart meters is proposed. Secondly, the paper develops the coordinated charging power scheduling strategy based on ECC. Finally, the strategy is verified via real-world charging and residential load data in Hangzhou, China. The results indicate that the strategy effectively reduces EV users' costs, peak load, and peak-valley difference.

articleTitle: Load Tracking Method Incorporating Static Voltage Characteristics in Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The broadscale grid integration of renewable energy posts threat on the adequacy of regulation capability of power systems. Virtual Power Plant (VPP) is thus receiving increasing attention due to its ability to provide trustworthy adjustment capability. When conducting load tracking tasks, the Static Voltage Characteristics (SVCs) are usually ignored, which could lead to abnormal operation of distributed energy resources sensitive to voltage variations. In this paper, A load tracking method considering SVC is proposed, where the SVC of PV inverter, energy storage device and Inverter Air Conditioner (IAC) are considered by equality constraints in load tracking models. This method is able to ensure the conduction of load tracking in VPP without affecting the normal operation of loads. An experiment is setup based on an improved IEEE 13-bus power system to analyze the effects of whether to consider SVC and regulation capability of IAC on load tracking performances.

articleTitle: Fault Line Selection Method for Small Current Grounding System Based on Multi-Group GA-BP Neural Networks Model
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In China's distribution network, which works with voltages from 6kV to 35kV, the low current grounding device is commonly adopted. The idea is to use a multi-group GA-BP neural networks model to choose single-phase grounding fault lines in low current grounding systems. With this method, you can use multi-fault features to get high-accuracy line selection in settings with complex distribution networks. The first group of GA-BP neural networks model is made with different factors, including the zero sequence current amplitude, the zero sequence current phase angle, the fifth harmonic amplitude, the fifth harmonic phase angle, and the transient current amplitude. After that, the result of the first model is used to found the second GA-BP neural network model that selects fault lines. In the end, MATLAB/Simulink is used to make sure that simulations are correct. The results show that this method works even when there are complex and variable failure environments and can get around the problem of having to use just one fault characteristic to choose a line. Because of this, it greatly improves the accuracy of choosing the fault line.

articleTitle: Improved High Voltage Ride-Through Control Strategy for Single-Stage PV System Based on Dynamic Reactive Power Support
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Operating at unity power factor in the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) mode is the most common control scheme for single-stage photovoltaic (PV) systems. However, with rising grid voltage, the PV inverter may experience overmodulation and subsequently lose control. Therefore, an improved high voltage ride-through (HVRT) control strategy, incorporating a variable DC-link voltage reference and dynamic reactive power support, is proposed. Initially, the model of a single-stage PV system is introduced. Subsequently, the fault characteristics of this system under high voltage conditions are analyzed. Subsequently, the improved control strategy, incorporating dynamic reactive power control, is integrated into the traditional dual-loop control scheme. Finally, simulation cases validate that the proposed control can prevent over-modulation and provide dynamic reactive power support.

articleTitle: Effect of inductive loads on cable impedance spectrum and localization results
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Cable impedance spectrum has emerged as a promising technique for detecting potential hidden defects in power cables. This method has been extensively studied and implemented, predominantly with measurements taken under open-circuit condition at the cable end. However, practical challenges arise when the cable end loads cannot be easily disconnected, potentially compromising the results of existing localization algorithms. Given that end loads in power systems are typically inductive, this paper addresses the scenario of purely inductive loads at the cable ends and investigates the impact of such loads on the localization accuracy of hidden defects when disconnection is not feasible. This study aims to extend the application scope of impedance spectrum-based localization techniques.

articleTitle: Optimization for Photovoltaic-Charging-Storage Microgrids Serving as Backup Power Sources for Commercial and Industrial Load Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Commercial and industrial load center are usually equipped with diesel generators or fixed energy storage as backup power sources, which present issues such as environmental pollution, noise pollution, and low asset utilization rates. The study explores the use of Photovoltaic-Charging-Storage Microgrids (PCSM) as backup power for commercial and industrial load centers and investigates the optimization scheduling methods for PCSM in this context. An optimization scheduling model for ensuring power supply at commercial and industrial load centers is established, aiming for the lowest operational cost of the PCSM, with the constraints considering the reserved discharge capacity of the energy storage system when used as backup power. A case study shows the effectiveness of the established model and the optimization results between the PCSM acting as backup power and without acting as backup power are compared.

articleTitle: Two-level Planning for Novel Power Systems Based on Copula Theory and Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel power system planning method based on Copula theory and deep reinforcement learning. Firstly, Copula theory is used to solve the correlation and uncertainty of wind and solar power generation. Then, by generating realistic scenarios of wind and solar output, we develop a two-level optimization model that combines investment decision-making and operational simulation for a new power system. The lower-level model is formulated as a mixed-integer second-order cone programming problem, which can be solved using the CPLEX solver. The upper-level model is a decision-making model that employs a deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on the deep deterministic policy gradient to enable dynamic planning decisions in the new power system. Finally, case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in significantly reducing investment and construction costs for power systems.

articleTitle: A Multi-Stage Rural Electrification Planning Method Considering Network Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Rural electrification planning plays a crucial role in advancing the grid connection transformation projects in rural areas. However, in the multi-stage expansion process of existing rural electrification planning, there is limited research on network connectivity. This lack of research leads to convergence issues with the phase angles of isolated nodes separated from the balance node. This paper proposes an artificial load demand method to construct anti-islanding constraints suitable for electrification planning. This approach ensures the connectivity of extension lines with the existing network. Based on optimizing the capacity allocation of wind and solar energy storage in off-grid microgrids, the optimal electrification scheme for unelectrified nodes is determined. The effectiveness of this method is validated through simulation case studies.

articleTitle: Calculation Model and Method of Adjustable Potential Depth of Charging Station and Changing Station Participating in Intraday Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a model and method for calculating the adjustable potential depth of the power station participating in the daily demand response. Firstly, the historical data cleaning and filtering model is constructed on the basis of collecting the data information of the charging station. Then, the baseline load calculation model and the forecast load calculation model of the charging station are established. Secondly, the lower and upper adjustable potential depth calculation models are constructed. Finally, the full-time matrix model of the lower and upper adjustable potential depth is constructed, and the data information of the charging station is output. This paper presents a refined model and method for calculating the adjustable potential depth of the power station participating in intraday demand response. It is helpful to explore and analyze the adjustable potential of charging station resources, help to improve the accuracy of reporting the adjustable potential when load aggregators and power users assist charging station resources to participate in daily demand response, and provide reference and guidance for charging station resources to participate in virtual power plant, demand response, direct scheduling, interactive potential analysis and regulation of network load, etc.

articleTitle: Discussion on Mapping-Based Plug and Play Technology in Web-Based Cellular Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to cope with the energy crisis, web-based cellular distribution network with high independent decision-making ability and efficient collective coordination ability has become a new development direction of distribution network. In this paper, a plug-and-play technology based on a three-layer model mapping scheme is proposed for the access and automatic upgrading of new intelligent terminals and power electronic devices in the web-based cellular distribution network scenario, as well as the dynamic reconfiguration of the cell. It can realize the automatic identification and parameter configuration of intelligent control terminals, support the control of intelligent terminals and power electronic devices by cell edge devices, and further support the update and upgrade process of intelligent devices and the dynamic reorganization process of the cell. Aiming at the problem of model inconsistency in the web-based cellular distribution network scenario, this paper first proposes a mapping scheme between the three layers of the distribution master station model, the cell edge device model and the intelligent control terminal model. Then, the implementation process of the plug and play mechanism is described. Finally, this paper discusses the dynamic topology identification and device configuration process in the process of cell dynamic reconfiguration. The proposed plug-and-play architecture can support the process of cell reconfiguration.

articleTitle: A Method for Suppressing High Frequency Resonance on MMC Converter Supplementary Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
