abstract: For the high frequency resonance of MMC HVDC system, the MMC HVDC converter and the AC line impedance characteristics dependent frequency are analysed, and their mathematic model are established. The paper analyses the negative resistance inductivity characteristic of the modular multi-level converter in middle high frequency range, and proposes that the converter control circuit delay, feedforward voltage and cross-coupling term are the main factors causing the converter impedance change. Based on the above, the method of suppressing resonance of high-frequency with a low-pass filter in the control circuit improves the impedance characteristics of MMC converter, and makes the converter impedance frequency characteristics not meet the resonance condition. Using the PSCAD model of the Chongqing to Hubei BTB interconnection project, the correctness is verified by the detailed PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Fast Decision Generation for Building Energy Management System Decisions Based on Behavior Cloning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy resources increases, their inherent uncertainty demands increased flexibility in power systems. As major power consumers, the heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) systems in buildings are increasingly being dispatched as demand-side flexible resources. Recent studies mainly focus on model predictive control (MPC) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the hardware level of most current buildings is insufficient to apply these methods. To tackle this issue, behavior cloning (BC) is used to clone the policies of these advanced approaches with lower hardware demands. Firstly, the MPC is used to obtain the expert demonstration data. Secondly, the learner policy is generated via BC. Finally, a precise HVAC system model is established based on EnergyPlus to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Simulation results show the proposed method can achieve efficient control of building HVAC systems with low hardware requirements.

articleTitle: Fully Decentralized P2P Energy Trading in Electrical Distribution Systems with Hybrid Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading within an electrical distribution system facilitates the sharing of benefits among various participants and the effective integration of distributed renewable energy. Meanwhile, the involvement of hybrid renewable energy, e.g., photovoltaic (PV) systems and wind turbine generators (WTGs), in P2P energy trading is essential for enhancing energy flexibility and diversity in active distribution networks. To this end, the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is employed to achieve a P2P energy trading strategy with the fully decentralized mode in this work, where self-interested participants attain optimal P2P energy trading results iteratively through multilateral negotiation. The simulation case is conducted in IEEE 33-bus with WTG data from Finland and PV data from Portugal to show the effectiveness of the developed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Investigation on the Evolution of Insulation Performance of BOPP Films for Power Capacitors Under Multi Physical Fields Aging
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important part of flexible HVDC transmission, the polypropylene film of power capacitor will undergo irreversible insulation aging and breakdown under the long-term effect of electricity-heat-stress. In order to study the effect of electro-thermal-stress multi-physical field aging on the insulation performance evolution of biaxially oriented polypropylene film for power capacitors, the BOPP film with a thickness of 5.8 μm was aged for 168 h at 235 kV / mm, 60°C and 10 N. The infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray diffraction (XRD), dielectric properties, DC breakdown and conductivity tests of the samples were carried out. The results show that with the application of multi-physical fields, the sample did not undergo crystal transformation, but caused molecular chain breakage and free radical formation, and produced some low molecular products. The application of electric and thermal fields leads to the decline in breakdown field strength of BOPP film, and the maximum decrease of breakdown field strength can reach 17 %, and promotes the increase of dielectric loss and conductivity. Additionally, given the long-term influence of stress field and thermal field, the aged sample's dielectric constant decreases significantly, while the effect of electric field is opposite. The above results show that the aging effect of multi-physical field leads to the decrease of electrical properties of BOPP film for capacitor, which should be paid more attention and studied.

articleTitle: Earth Fault Detection Method for TN-C-S Systems Based on Residual Current Shunt Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: TN-C-S systems are widely used in low-voltage distribution networks (LVDNs). However, the PEN conductor of the TN-C-S system is earthed at multiple points, causing changes in residual currents during load switching. Existing earth fault detection methods cannot distinguish this residual current change caused by load switching, which will lead to mal-operation. To address this problem, the residual currents during a steady state, load switching, and an earth fault are derived. It is found that the residual current shunt coefficient during load switching is the same as that in the steady state, but is different from that during the earth fault. Record the residual current shunt coefficient when devices are powered on. Then, calculate the residual current deviation shunt coefficient when the residual current changes. Earth faults can be discriminated by comparing the difference between the calculated shunt coefficients and the recorded shunt coefficients. The reliability of the proposed method was verified by both digital simulations and physical tests in an actual LVDN.

articleTitle: Design of Phase-locked Loop Based on Filter-Enhanced Double Third-order Generalized Integrator
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale grid-connection of new energy generators requires reliable grid synchronization signals, while phase-locked loop (PLL) technology is a universal method to detect these signals from the power grid due to its accuracy and high speed. However, the common PLL technology can only work in ideal grid conditions due to the lack of anti-interference capability. Hence, a filter-enhanced PLL technology is proposed to eliminate disturbances so as to realize stable phase-detection in non-ideal grid conditions. Firstly, the improved structure of the PLL technology is proposed. Subsequently, the model of the proposed PLL technology is built to analyze its filtering performance and the parameters of the controller are obtained accordingly. Finally, an environment of simulation is designed to test the performance of the proposed PLL technology. Additionally, an interference resistance experiment is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed PLL technology in practical applications.

articleTitle: Field Application of Defect Localization and Extending Life Technology for XLPE Cables in Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to statistics from State Grid Corporation of China, a large number of cable lines in operation are subjected to varying degrees of moisture or water ingress. The proportion of moisture and water ingress lines exceeds 60%. Among them, more than 80% of cables are affected by moisture or moisture intrusion at cable joints, leading to breakdown. The paper summarizes the defect localization method and repair technology of cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cables in response to the problems of moisture and water tree aging in large-scale cables in urban power grids. Firstly, it introduces the principle and implementation scheme of precise localization technology for local defects in distribution cables based on frequency domain reflection method; Secondly, it elaborates on the use of organic silicon repair technology to extend the service life of water tree aging XLPE cables and improve insulation performance; Finally, it introduces successful field application cases of defect localization and repair technology.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Prefabricated Optical Cable Connector in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The universal interchange of prefabricated optical cable connectors is of great significance for the modular construction of smart substation, but there is no unified standard before, and there are great limitations in the scale application of engineering. This article summarizes the characteristics of existing optical cable connectors, through the performance analysis and quantitative evaluation of optical cable connectors, it is proposed that the optical cable connectors using MT contact parts, built-in mounting parts and standard housing parts have the best cost performance in power applications. In this paper, the standardization scheme of J599-MT optical cable connector is described. The optical cable connector produced according to this has good general interchangeable performance, and fully meets the requirements of modular construction and operation and maintenance of substation.

articleTitle: Intelligent Substation SCD File Verification and Differentiated Display Method for Security Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A security oriented intelligent substation SCD file verification and differentiated display method is proposed to address the issues of low efficiency and high error rates in traditional manual verification methods. Firstly, use Levenshtein distance algorithm to verify the parsed substation configuration description (SCD) text. Then, based on the knowledge graph, the verified and error free SCD file is visualized and displayed. Finally, the RKR-GST algorithm is used to compare different versions of SCD files and visually display their differentiated details. Based on the SCD file of a 220kV intelligent substation, experimental analysis is conducted on the proposed method. The results shows that the verification accuracy mostly exceeds 95%, and the differences between SCD file versions are visually displayed, which can be well applied to the safety control of intelligent substations.

articleTitle: The Principle and Implementation of Fast Protection Based on Busbar Residual Voltage Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of the busbar residual voltage maintenance system on relay protection and develops a fast protection that can be used in the power system containing the busbar residual voltage maintenance system. The protection method is based on the fault current analysis under the working condition of the busbar residual voltage maintenance system when the power shaking occurs in the enterprise power system. It can take into account the speed, reliability and selectivity of the protection before and after the busbar residual voltage protection action, and effectively improve the power supply reliability of the enterprise power grid. Finally, the protection principle and the implementation method are verified through the RTDS simulation test.

articleTitle: Pre-Trained Large Model Based Automatic Generation of Defect Insulator Images for Power Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The imbalance between normal and defect insulator samples brings biases to the neural network, misleading to overfitting and misclassification. To tackle this problem, we propose an image generation method leveraging pre-trained Large Models (LMs) to augment defect samples, especially cap-exploded insulators. Specifically, we devise the cap segment module to generate semantic mask covering insulator caps. Subsequently, the inpainting module repairs the blocked regions with the background, creating cap-explosion-like defect samples. We investigate the optimal injection rate of pseudo images and assess the generation quality. Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) is utilized to select useful generated samples to retrain and enhance performance. Comparative experiments are conducted on a dataset comprising 1203 normal insulators and 383 defect ones. Our method improves detection F1 scores up to 7% and 21 % on ResNet18 and ViT-B/16, respectively.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Design of Auxiliary Power Supply for Urban Rail Transit Emergency Ventilation System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The auxiliary power supply requirements of urban rail transit emergency ventilation system are complex, and the traditional voltage regulator power module is large and high cost, so it needs a switching power supply solution with high efficiency, low cost and high power density. Based on UC3843 chip, a multi-output isolated switching power supply is designed. The principle of circuit topology is analyzed, and the high frequency transformer, starting circuit, clock oscillation circuit and feedback loop circuit are designed. Voltage and current double closed loop is used to adjust the output voltage, and has the function of overcurrent protection. After experimental debugging, the auxiliary power supply designed is small in volume, low in cost, stable in performance and meets the design requirements, and improves the power density and economic benefit of emergency ventilation equipment.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based On Characteristic Redundancy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Real time measurement data has the characteristics of high dimension, feature redundancy, and insufficient weight of boundary information, which is not conducive to transient stability assessment. Feature redundancy and fuzzy boundary information are not conducive to transient stable boundary fitting; Category imbalance leads to the model paying more attention to most class samples. In this paper, the improved random forest assessment feature importance is used to obtain the sample stability, and the samples with high stability are deleted to increase the boundary sample weight; Combining the feature independence determined by improved k-means++to obtain the optimal feature subset to reduce feature redundancy. The example shows that the processed samples have the characteristics of no redundancy of features and heavy weight of boundary samples, thus effectively improving the transient stability evaluation performance of the model.

articleTitle: Anti-Islanding Protection Method for Ratio Measurement by Voltage Signal Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Anti-islanding protection based on impedance measurement can effectively avoid the problems of refusal and maloperation. But existing methods fail to establish a unified identification criterion in different islanding systems, and the mutual interference of the detection signals in the multi-DG system will lead to the protection failure. In this regard, a new islanding identification method is constructed by utilizing the ratio of the islanding detection signal to the grid voltage, which frees the criterion setting from the dependence on the system impedance parameter. In addition, the self-synchronization strategy proposed in this method allows each DG to synchronize the injected signals spontaneously by using the islanding detection signal and the voltage crossing point. Finally, simulation experiments based on a real-time digital simulation system (RTDS) verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the present methods.

articleTitle: An AVC Optimization Strategy Based on Improved Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An AVC optimization strategy based on improved deep reinforcement learning is proposed to address the problem of traditional voltage control methods being unable to meet the voltage regulation requirements of new power systems. Firstly, an AVC optimization model is constructed with the objectives of voltage, main transformer tap changer, and capacitor operation times, including modeling of on load tap changers and reactive power compensation capacitor banks to comprehensively improve voltage stability. Then, an improved Twin Delay Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm is introduced to optimize the Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) and applied to solve the AVC optimization model to obtain reliable optimization measures. Finally, experimental analysis is conducted on the proposed strategy based on the IEEE-33 node system. The results show that the optimization results of the proposed strategy are the most ideal, with average voltage deviation, tap action times, capacitor action times, and optimization time divided into 0.0015p. u, 5 times, 6 times, and 36ms, which can provide effective control strategies for actual power grid operation.

Author Keywords: improved twin delay deep deterministic policy gradient

articleTitle: A Method for Evaluating the Timing Response Potential of Load-Side Resource Clusters Considering Uncertain Influencing Factors and Response Dynamic Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase in the proportion of renewable energy, the role of load-side resources in power grid dispatching and operation has become crucial. This paper proposes a method for evaluating the time series response potential of load-side resource clusters, which takes into account uncertain influencing factors and response dynamic processes. First, the technology of combining integrated empirical mode decomposition with stacked denoising autoencoders is used to extract electricity consumption characteristics; then, based on these characteristics, the key response parameters are calculated using the consumer psychology model to form a potential characterization model with a probability distribution of response potential. Data tests on a provincial power grid show that this method can effectively capture the response potential of load-side resource groups and provide a practical decision support tool for power grid operators and resource managers.

articleTitle: Distributed Service Restoration Strategy for Interconnected Distribution Networks with Generalized Benders Decomposition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The main transformer fault may cause large-scale power outages of distribution networks (DNs) and bring tremendous impact on the social and economic development. Fully exploiting the potential of areas interconnection and grid flexibility in DNs could improve the resilience of power grid as well as the reliability of power supply. In this context, this paper proposes a distributed service restoration strategy for interconnected DNs with the generalized Benders decomposition algorithm. Firstly, the power restoration optimization models of power outage DN and normal DNs are established with the objectives of maximum load restoration and minimum network losses, respectively. Secondly, with the principle of generalized Benders decomposition method, the global optimization model is decomposed into the main problem of power outage DN and the sub-problems of normal DNs, which are calculated alternately. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed distributed service restoration strategy are simulated and verified using a real interconnected DNs case in China.

articleTitle: Electric-Thermal Joint State Estimation Method for Oilfield Micro-Energy Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Oilfield Micro-Energy Network (OMEN) is a coupling system of DC microgrid and heating network. To achieve accurate perception of the operating status of OMEN, state estimation (SE) is required. Therefore, this paper proposes an electric-thermal joint state estimation method for OMEN. Firstly, the measurement model of oilfield DC microgrid and the measurement model of coupling equipment are established, and the influence of the coupling link on the measurement redundancy and result accuracy is analyzed. Then, considering the independence of DC microgrid and heating network in OMEN and the coupling relationship between them, a distributed solution algorithm is adopted to improve the accuracy of the results. Finally, the case is simulated and analyzed by Matlab to verify the effectiveness of this state estimation method in result accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Intelligent Charging Pile Prototype System for “Net-Pile-Vehicle” Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper provides a design scheme for an electric vehicle charging pile prototype system. The system can remotely control the charging power through the collaborative work of the network, charging piles, and electric vehicles. The control means and methods used in it have certain reference value for the improvement of actual charging piles and their deep integration with the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Optimization Technology with Metro Vehicle Networking (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing scale of electric vehicles, the randomness and fluctuation of their power pose a challenge to the stable operation of the power grid. In order to realize the effective aggregation and flexible invocation of various resources, this paper constructs a virtual power plant system model including distributed photovoltaic, wind power, gas turbine, energy storage and electric vehicle. Based on this, a virtual power plant output plan is developed and the maximum output of electric vehicles is constrained by penetration ratio. In order to maximize the economic benefit, the optimal operation model of virtual power plant with metro vehicle network was constructed, and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm combining Circle mapping and elite reverse learning was used to solve the problem. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example analysis.

articleTitle: Novel Buck-Type Active Power-Decoupling Control Strategy for Single-Phase Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The active power decoupling is an effective solution to deal with the inherent dc-link power fluctuation of single-phase converter. The available control strategies are facing the challenge of low power decoupling accuracy and complicate controller design because the reference usually include plenty of harmonics. In this paper, a buck-type active power decoupling circuit is employed to absorb the ripple power. The system model with the control object of the square of the auxiliary capacitance voltage is creatively established. Thanks to this, the reference of control object only contains a double-frequency ac component and a dc offset, the controller design could be greatly simplified and the power decoupling accuracy would increase. For the control scheme, a second order filter is used to accurately extract the double-frequency ripple power to further construct the reference. And the dual closed-loop control structure is employed to tune the control object. The effectiveness of the proposed active power decoupling strategy is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Control Strategy for Wind Farm Frequency Regulation and Backup Considering Wind Speed Differences
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The doubly fed fan is connected through an inverter, causing the unit speed and system frequency to decouple and unable to proactively respond to frequency changes in the system. With the increase of mass wind power grid connection capacity, wind turbines should have a portion of backup capacity and be able to undertake some frequency regulation tasks. In response to this issue, this article proposes a frequency regulation reserve capacity allocation strategy for doubly fed wind farms, prioritizing the use of low wind speed units to provide frequency regulation reserve capacity, ensuring the utilization of wind energy. Usually, only a portion of the wind turbines need to be controlled, simplifying the complexity of control. The simulation proved that the proposed strategy enables the wind farms to meet load reduction and backup requirements while ensuring wind energy utilization efficiency; When load disturbances occur, it can quickly provide active power and improve the frequency characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of User-Side Photovoltaic -Energy Storage Systems Operation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The stochastic characteristics of photovoltaic (PV) power generation impact the stability of power systems. Hence, PV power crucial for effective scheduling within PV-energy storage systems (ESS). The prediction model employs the improved artificial hummingbird algorithm-back propagation neural network (IAHA-BPNN). Based on the prediction results, a multi-objective function is constructed to optimize the strategy with the objectives of minimizing the cost of tariffs, minimizing the peak-to-valley deviation of the grid power and squaring the deviation of the grid power. The findings show that the model presents exemplary performance, and the operational strategy successfully mitigates demand. The reduction in electricity costs for users not only alleviates the burden of electricity bills but also facilitates enhanced energy management, thereby improving the efficiency and economic advantages of the PV-ESS.

articleTitle: A Correction Method for Active Distribution Network Loss Calculation Considering the Spatiotemporal Distribution Characteristics of Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional loss calculation method of distribution network is usually based on time section or average power flow analysis, which fails to fully consider the dynamic spatiotemporal change of load and the influence of distributed power access, thus restricting its calculation accuracy. The increasingly perfect load side monitoring method provides data support for improving the theoretical loss calculation accuracy of distribution network. By combining the shape coefficient of the load curve and the improved electrical distance based on the complex efficiency of power transmission, a modified coefficient of the traditional theoretical loss calculation model based on the power flow calculation is constructed in this paper. The marginal network loss coefficient is introduced to characterize the difference of influence of load unit power change on the loss of distribution network before and after the access of distributed power, and the theoretical loss calculation correction coefficient including distributed power is improved. The correction method can effectively improve the accuracy of theoretical calculation results of distribution network loss. The effectiveness of this method is proved by comparing the result of case analysis.

articleTitle: Reliability and Sensitivity Model for Bipolar MMC-HVDC Including States of Sub-modules
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high voltage dc (HVDC) is flexible for control. Its reliability analysis is of important application value. The state space model of the bipolar MMC-HVDC including the sub modules (SMs) is proposed in this paper. The equivalent outage hours (EOH) and the bipolar availability (BA) are calculated. The availability of MMC (AMMC) and reduction rate of EOH (αEoH) are newly defined in this paper. The analytical expression of the sensitivity of reliability indices with respect to the redundancy number is newly derived. The numerical analysis compares the reliabilities of the MMC-HVDC and the VSC-HVDC. The MMC-HVDC with different numbers of redundant SMs is evaluated to verify the necessity of considering the availability of the SMs.

articleTitle: Model- free Power Flow Calculation of Distribution Networks Considering Incomplete Observability and High Photovoltaic Penetration
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the incomplete observability of the distribution grid and the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, traditional power flow calculations face challenges in terms of both accuracy and speed. This paper proposes a model-free power flow calculation that investigates the performance of power flow calculation under incomplete observability and the presence of photovoltaic (PV) generation. Simulation results carried out in IEEE 14-bus, IEEE 39-bus and IEEE 118-bus test systems demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method in terms of both accuracy and speed, even when accounting for incomplete observability and high penetration of photovoltaic systems.

articleTitle: Quantitative Assessment of Demand Response Capabilities of Electric Vehicles as Flexible Resources Across Different Time Periods
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy, the increasing volatility in energy supply presents challenges for the development of smart grids. Demand response (DR), as an important means, provides significant assistance in addressing this challenge. Additionally, as the number of electric vehicles (EVs) continues to grow, it becomes increasingly important to harness the potential of these mobile energy storage resources and explore their flexibility in DR capabilities. In this paper, considering the inherent constraints of electric vehicle (EV) charging and discharging demands, we have developed a methodology to evaluate the DR capabilities of EVs' flexibility resources across different time periods. Additionally, it considers the impact of two different charging modes on the DR capability of EVs at each moment. Finally, by utilizing a real-world dataset of EV behaviors, we assessed their flexibility and response capabilities, offering a reliable reference for the integration of EVs into DR within the power system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Terminal State Recognition in the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a state recognition algorithm for the intelligent terminal in the distribution network to combine the two functions of state assessment and fault recognition in condition-based maintenance. Secondly, this paper utilizes the probability distribution to reflect the likelihood of the terminal being in the normal state or a specific failure, which indicates the probability of the terminal transitioning to other states and enhances failure warning. Moreover, since there exists the performance limitation caused by the difficulty of collecting fault data in practical scenarios, this paper utilizes supervised comparative learning to address the few-shot problem and learns a representation space characterizing the state probability distribution. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in state recognition and fault warning is validated through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Forced Oscillation Source Identification in Power System Using Voltage Oscillation Ratio
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Complex and untypical forced oscillation may occur in modern power system due to the wide use of power electronic equipment, and traditional method is difficult to identify these kinds of oscillation. A general identification method is proposed in this paper, which is based on voltage oscillation ratio, according to the fact that the voltage oscillation ratio at the oscillation source is the highest. First extract the fluctuation component and steady-state component of voltage from measured data, then calculate the normalized voltage oscillation ratio, i.e., fluctuating component compared to steady-state component, and finally identify the forced oscillation source which has the largest ratio. This method is suitable for both low-frequency oscillation and sub/super synchronous oscillation, and is immune to the systematic measurement error, and can be used across different voltage levels. The effectiveness of this method is verified by simulation and field cases.

articleTitle: Admittance Matrices-Based Oscillation Case Studies: A Realistic Distribution System with High Penetration of PVs
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of increasing proportion of renewable energy resources, power electronic equipment of the voltage source converters (VSCs) has been significantly integrated into the grid. This paper conducts case studies using actual data from a photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected system in a specific distribution system of Beijing and analyzes oscillation characteristics and stability. The network full-order admittance matrix fitting method was first introduced to fit the admittance matrices of four regions in the area, obtaining the state-space equations and poles of the PV grid-connected system. Real data was used to simulate six PV nodes in the area by establishing nonlinear oscillation analytical model. The impact of renewable energy penetration on nonlinear oscillations was also explored. Finally, by analyzing the pole positions and simulation results, the stability of the PV grid-connected system in all regions of the area was analyzed.

articleTitle: Two-Layer Optimization Method of Web of Cells Network Considering Source-Load Flexibility Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The uncertainty and volatility caused by the current high proportion of distributed generation access have brought new challenges to the economy and security of distribution network. Therefore, a Two-layer optimization method of web of cells network is proposed, which considers the uncertainty of source and load. Firstly, the flexibility of various source-load in the distribution network are considered, and the flexibility evaluation index is established from the flexibility supply and demand balance and branch channel adequacy. Secondly, a Two-layer optimization model of distribution network considering economy and flexibility is established. The upper model takes the grid division strategy of distribution network as the decision-making subject, and the lower model takes the flexibility of supply and demand side to adjust the output of resources as the decision-making subject. Finally, the simulation results verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Lifespan of Temperature Sensors in Medium-Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of smart grids, the demand for online condition monitoring of switchgear is increasing. A variety of temperature measurement products are used in monitoring of important equipment. This paper sorts out various online temperature measurement technologies, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of different technologies, and focuses on the evaluation methods of the reliability and service life of online temperature measurement products. This article describes the basic principles of accelerated life testing and Arrhenius acceleration model, and based on the Arrhenius' model, analyzes the lifespan of the temperature sensor, and derives the temperature-life curve, which is based on different loads scenarios. A temperature portfolio based on load distribution and corresponding temperature is proposed which makes the assessment more consistent with the real operation conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Active Distribution Considering Uncertainties in Wind and Solar Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This article aims to optimally schedule an active distribution considering uncertainties in both wind and solar power generations. In this respect, an optimal scheduling model to minimize electricity interaction and maximize the autonomous defense capability of active distribution, achieving economical and efficient operation is firstly developed; a sampling and clustering approach is then introduced to quantify the uncertainty in both wind and solar power generations; and an improved genetic algorithm is finally proposed to solve the corresponding optimal scheduling problem. The numerical results from the case study demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively manages the uncertainty in wind and solar power integration, leading to more stable and cost-efficient power system scheduling.

articleTitle: A Framework of Electricity Carbon Monitoring for Low-Voltage Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electricity carbon monitoring is fundamental to the reduction of carbon dioxide emissions., which is crucial for controlling global warming. Most existing studies focus primarily on high-voltage grids., such as those operating at 220kV and 500kV., thus neglecting users within low-voltage grids. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a novel framework for electricity carbon measurement specifically tailored for low-voltage grids. The proposed framework integrates an end-layer consisting of smart electric energy meter., a side-layer consisting of smart metering concentrator, and a cloud layer consisting of metering server., which facilitates and improves the transparency of electricity carbon monitoring.

articleTitle: Improved Spectral Clustering for Distributed Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In addressing the issue of exponential increase in solution time with the growing number of simulations when using mixed-integer linear programming methods to solve stochastic models based on Monte Carlo simulation, this paper proposes employing spectral clustering to determine the best-quality classification scheme. By using the spectral clustering method on random samples generated by Monte Carlo simulation, the optimal classification scheme is identified to group similar stochastic scenarios together. Finally, by selecting the center of each class as a representative, the number of scenarios to be considered is reduced, facilitating the solution of problems such as whole-scenario modeling and lowering the difficulty of solving. Experimental results demonstrate that the spectral clustering method proposed in this paper exhibits the best performance among some commonly used methods.

articleTitle: Research on Precise Control of Distribution Network Based on Multivariate Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a mathematical model based on variational mode decomposition to achieve precise control of distribution network power flow, in response to the non-stationary, temporal correlation, and nonlinear characteristics of time series of multivariate power load data. The model takes the active power of multiple loads as the original data and acquires the analysis results by improving the variational mode decomposition of the stopping criterion. Extract the energy values of each component as features, and classify the signal through a deep confidence network. The simulation results prove that the model can effectively predict multiple load data.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Diagnosis of High Voltage Side Bushing of 500kV Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzed and diagnosed a fault of 500kV high voltage bushing, and found insulation damage in phase A of the bushing by insulating oil chromatography test and high voltage test. The fault type of the bushing was analyzed and judged by characteristic gas method. According to the inspection results of bushing disintegration, the accuracy of analysis and judgment results is verified.

articleTitle: A Localized Distribution Line Protection Method for Fast Fault Isolation and System Restoration
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution system directly serves electricity users and is a crucial link in ensuring stable, reliable, and high-quality power supply. In distribution line operation, if faults are not handled properly, large amount of time and manual efforts will be taken to isolate and repair the faulted area, resulting in low electricity reliability and long outage time. This article proposes an innovative distribution line fault isolation and system recovery scheme that utilizes electrical signal spatio-temporal characteristics generated by breaker operation and is based only on local information. By isolating the fault from both ends, this protection scheme also lays the foundation for restoring power supply to the un-faulted section. With the function of one-side voltage-loss triggered closing for the distribution network tie breaker, the protection scheme achieves power supply restoration to un-faulted sections. Furthermore, by distinguishing between transient faults and permanent faults, the protection scheme further optimizes the control of the tie breakers, reducing the negative impact on device lifespan brought by the fault recovery processes in traditional local automation schemes.

articleTitle: Case Studies of AC & DC Hybrid Power Distribution Grid Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-segmented, multi-connected, mesh-shaped AC/DC seamless hybrid flexible power distribution system (FPDS) and a grid structure model based on power electronic technologies and power cyber-physical system (PCPS), featured with key innovation namely Local Area Grids (LAGs) and sub-LAGs. LAGs are based on a series of key novel distribution equipment, including power routers, power switches, and power hubs. This structure is similar to the Internet, which changes the radial mode and weakly-connected structure of DN (Distribution Network), and forms an AC & DC hybrid flexible DN. The series new equipment, power router, power switch, and power hub, with the functions of P-CPS are given. Replacing the multiple transformers, controllers, and compensation equipment with a single integrated equipment can significantly reduce the equipment diversity and complexity caused by the integration of DER, support the deep integration of power physical systems and power cyber systems from the technical aspect, and facilitate user participation in DN operation and management. Finally, based on the FPDS single-node system, simulations and physical prototype tests are performed on the proposed new distribution devices. This paper has important reference value for flexible control of AC/DC hybrid DN and friendly access of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Based EV-RSU Mapping Method for EVC-Assisted Multi-Tier VEC System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), latency sensitive intelligent tasks require efficient processing, which can be improved through multi-tier vehicular edge computing (VEC). Previous study has proposed an advanced electric vehicle cluster (EVC) assisted multi-tier VEC system, which aims to jointly optimize offloading and resource allocation for road task vehicles (RTVs) and manage charging power for smart electric vehicles (EVs) using a game strategy to enhance system efficiency. Building on this previous work, our study employs a Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm to optimize the EV-RSU mapping, identifying the limitations of Nash equilibrium (NE) in handling large-scale vehicles and more complex tasks. The simulation results demonstrate that as the number of RTVs and the initial queue length in the RSU increasing the proposed DQN-based EV-RSU mapping method shows the minimum system average latency.

articleTitle: Identification of Weak Links in Transmission Networks Based on Line Flexibility Evaluation (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To identify the bottlenecks of insufficient flexibility in existing transmission networks, this paper proposes a method for identifying weak links in transmission networks based on line flexibility evaluation. Firstly, the flexibility supply and demand at nodes are quantitatively analyzed and converted into the flexibility supply and demand of transmission lines. Secondly, the definitions of line flexibility resource supply, line flexibility carrying capacity, and line flexibility margin are introduced to identify the causes of insufficient grid flexibility. Furthermore, an optimal economic operation model of the grid is established, and an 8760-hour sequential operation simulation is conducted to obtain the flexibility evaluation indicators of each line, thereby locating the weak links in the transmission network. Finally, the Garver 6-bus system is used as a simulation example to verify that the proposed method can effectively identify the bottlenecks of flexibility in existing transmission networks.

articleTitle: Discussion on “One-Click” Collection and Analysis Method of Index Results Based on Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Excel Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the process and result support of professional management, the accuracy and timeliness of indicators are the key factors to guide the direction and focus of management. The traditional manual data acquisition and analysis process has more flexibility, but it has a great challenge in terms of accuracy and personnel skill requirements. With the digital transformation of enterprises and the optimized development of index management, the index system has tended to the standard mode of system solidification and unified methods, and the demand for flexibility has decreased.. Therefore, with the increasing development of digital innovation, this paper selects Robotic process automation (RPA) and excel with low entry difficulty to automate the huge indicator analysis, achieve “one-click” collection and analysis, shorten labor time cost, weaken personnel skill requirements, and avoid errors easily caused by complex monitoring and analysis. In this paper, violation data analysis in the field of electric power safety is used for verification, and the results can be used, extended and popularized.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Collaborative Optimization Approach for New Energy and Energy Storage Clusters Considering Dynamic Limits of Multi-Level Cross-Sections
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: New energy clusters transmit across multiple voltage levels and multi-level sections have become a typical scenario of large-scale wind-solar base new energy concentrated transmission. However, as the proportion of new energy installations continues to rise, the aggregation level is continuously increasing as well, the actual transmission capacity of each section is greatly affected by the power flow distribution, and the coupling relationship between cross-section limits is complicated. Nowadays, the optimization scheduling strategy that only considers a single, static fixed-value cross-section limit of the cooperation of the new energy and the energy storage is no longer applicable. Therefore, the constraint expression of the dynamic time-varying limit of the section is proposed by multiple linear regression and then substituted into the day-ahead optimization model. Finally, a multi-level nested cross-section example in a province is selected for analysis, and the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Load Deviation Control Technology for Public Buildings Considering Uncertainty Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This study proposes a new building load control technology to solve the problem that the building load power is easily affected by uncertain factors, aiming at controlling the central air conditioning load to control the building power deviation within an acceptable range. Firstly, this study establishes the heat exchange model of public buildings and the energy consumption model of central air conditioning system. Then this study establishes the total cost function of public buildings by defining the cost optimization objective function, including the energy consumption cost of central air conditioning system and the penalty cost of not meeting the user's thermal comfort. Using the virtual queue and drift-plus penalty function established in Lyapunov optimization theory, the proposed control strategy is able to minimize the total building cost while controlling the power deviation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Coordinated Optimal Scheduling Considering Electric Vehicles and Air-conditioning Loads(CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the yearly increase of air conditioning (AC) usage in summer, the electric power system is facing great challenges. Meanwhile, electric vehicles (EVs), as an emerging power load, play an important role in alleviating the energy crisis. However, the disordered charging of large-scale EVs poses a significant threat to the safe and stable operation of the power system. To address this problem, a coordinated optimal scheduling method considering EV and AC loads is proposed. First, the EV charging load model and the AC load model are constructed; then, the coordinated optimal scheduling model is established with the objectives of minimizing the grid compensation cost and reducing the peak-to-valley difference of loads. Finally, the simulation results show that the method can effectively balance the grid load, reduce the pressure of electricity consumption during peak hours, and satisfy the electricity demand of users.

articleTitle: Fault Fast Self-Healing Strategy for Distribution Network Based on Primary and Secondary Fusion Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The conventional local feeder(FA) automation adopts voltage-time strategy, which results in long user power outage times and multiple switch actions during fault self-healing. This paper proposed a fast self-healing feeder automation strategy that can significantly reduce power outage time and switch actions. The segmented switch adopts functions such as fault detection and acceleration opening after voltage loss, short-term power opening after voltage loss, and acceleration opening and locking when closing to fault, in cooperation with the reclosing of outline switch to complete fault self-healing. Compared with the traditional voltage-time FA strategy, this strategy can reduce one reclosing of the outline switch, effectively reducing the number of line switch actions and fault outage time. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed fast self-healing strategy have been verified through true type platform system testing and practical application.

articleTitle: Combined-Loop Operation Control Strategy for Medium-Voltage Distribution Networks Based on Phase Shifter Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional structure of “closed-loop design and open-loop operation” of the traditional medium-voltage distribution network can no longer meet the development needs of “active generation”, “local consumption of distributed generation” and “flexible regulation” of the distribution network. At this stage, compared with the expensive power electronic converter device, the phase shifter transformer (referred to as the flexible interconnection phase shifter) has the characteristics of continuous adjustable phase shift angle, high cost performance, high energy density and easy maintenance, relying on the controllable flexible interconnection phase shifter interconnection to form a closed-loop operation network of medium voltage distribution network, and realize the common consumption of multiple feeders distributed power generation has become one of the cost-effective and feasible technical solutions. However, for the parameter control of the flexible interconnected phase shifter, the existing methods cannot take into account the power balance of the feeder side and the operation loss of the network of the closed loop operation on the basis of realizing the power consumption of distributed generator power generation in the network in the closed loop operation. In this paper, a closed-loop operation network system for medium-voltage distribution network based on phase shifter interconnection is provided, which can realize the closed-loop operation of 10kV network, and the power is flexible and controllable, so as to ensure that the access and consumption needs of distributed power generation and diversified loads can be met in a larger range.

articleTitle: Overview of Current Situation of Cascaded Medium and High Voltage Direct-Mounted Energy Storage Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with the traditional energy storage system, the cascaded medium and high voltage direct-mounted energy storage system has large capacity, high efficiency and broader development prospects. In this paper, the research status of cascaded medium and high voltage direct hanging energy storage technology is summarized. Firstly, the characteristics and topology of the cascaded direct storage system are briefly introduced, and then the research progress of the system control strategy, main circuit key technical parameter design, battery energy balance control method and other key technologies are emphatically discussed. Finally, the future research direction of the energy storage system is prospected.

articleTitle: Transient Synchronizing Stability Quantitative Assessment of Converter-Based Resources by Basin of Attraction
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the converter-based renewable power generation has been extensively integrated into grid, the transient synchronizing stability accidents of gird induced by voltage source convert (VSC) are emerging more and more frequently and severely. In this paper, the transient synchronizing dynamics of the VSC are depicted by a reduced-order model. Then, its transient synchronizing stability is examined and analyzed by the large-signal basin of attraction (BOA) of the VSC. The system shows two kinds of boundaries of the BOA under different parameters, including the closed-loop area and the fish-like area. The boundary of the closed-loop area is depicted by the equipotential plane estimation based on the energy function. The boundary of the fish-like area is estimated through the method of hyperplane in the first quadrant. Meanwhile, the transient synchronizing stability criteria can be established based on the estimated boundaries and the numerically integral fault trajectories. Furthermore, the critical clearing angle (CCA) is analytical calculated through the analytically derived fault trajectory under the worst fault conditions. Meanwhile, the critical clearing times (CCT) can also be analytical calculated. Both the analytical CCA and CCT can provide enough margin for the transient control and protection. Finally, several simulations have verified the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method in MATLAB.

articleTitle: A Sensitivity-Based Regulation Method for Tie-Line Power of AC Microgrid Cluster
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The microgrid cluster (MGC) system can improve distributed power utilization by interconnecting energy between microgrids in the cluster through tie-line. However, there is a security region for tie-line. When the tie-line power exceeds the limit, it would affect the safe and stability operation of the system. In this paper, we investigate the tie-line power regulation strategy of AC MGC that allows the tie-line power to reach the expected value. First, a centralized MGC operation architecture is built, and the direct control devices within the MGC are identified. Then, considering the diesel generator economic operation interval constraints, a sensitivity-based tie-line regulation strategy is proposed. In the strategy, the sensitivity of the output power of different devices to the power of the tie-line needs to be fitted in advance. Finally, different energy storage SOC state scenarios are set up for arithmetic simulation to verify the effectiveness of the strategy. The strategy enhances the level of control over MGC.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Energy Consumption Strategy Considering Distribution Network Connection Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the dual-carbon target, a large number of new energy sources are connected to the grid, resulting in a lack of multi-resource regulation and consumption problems. Aiming at the distribution network with multiple flexible resources, this paper proposed a cooperative control strategy of distribution network reconstruction based on multi-objective resources. Firstly, combined with the characteristics of power distribution, a multi-objective optimization and reconfiguration model is established and the maximization of new energy utilization is set as the optimization goal, and comprehensively considered multiple factors such as power demand at each time of the power system, non-stationary characteristics of distributed energy output, and the number of interconnection switching switches. Secondly, the improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization method was used, genetic variation was added, and factors such as network equalization, distributed power supply, node voltage, and energy storage capacity were comprehensively considered, making the solution found closer to the real optimal solution and realizing the optimization of new energy consumption ratio. Finally, the optimized model and algorithm were verified by using IEEE-33 node, and it was proved that the multi-objective dynamic reconfiguration distributed energy consumption strategy was feasible, the electricity consumption and stability of the distribution network were improved, and the operation cost and network loss were reduced.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Voltage/Var Control Strategy for Distribution Network Considering Resource Volatility Differences
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To mitigate the challenges posed by increased power loss and voltage fluctuation due to high-penetration photovoltaic integration, this paper introduces a Multi-Time Scale V oltageN ar Control framework for distribution networks. It integrates overall planning and scheduling of the distribution network on the day-ahead scale with real-time monitoring and adjustment of grid-connected points on the intra-day scale. On the day-ahead scale, a V oltageN ar Control model is formulated, aiming to minimize network loss and voltage deviation while considering constraints related to equipment and the distribution characteristics of uncertain variables. On the intra-day scale, a quantitative relationship between inverter adjustable power and target voltage is established, and a voltage autonomy model, relying solely on local real-time information, is developed. Simulation analysis using the modified IEEE 33 system validates the efficacy of the proposed voltage/var control strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Economic Dispatch of Hydrogen-Electricity Coupled Multi-Microgrid Considering Hydrogen Tube Trailers' Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of hydrogen technology and its expanding application in microgrids, the research on hydrogen and electricity interactions has become a critical area in the energy sector. In this paper, a hydrogen-electricity coupled multi-micro grid (MMG) energy interaction framework is established, which transfers hydrogen and electricity through hydrogen tube trailers and power lines. Then, an optimal economic dispatch model of the MMG is proposed. This model aims to minimize the operating cost of the MMG, considering the constraints of equipment, hydrogen tube trailers, and hydrogen-electricity balance. Finally, through case studies, the proposed optimal economic dispatch has been proven to reduce the operation cost of the MMG effectively, with a reduction of 3.6%.

articleTitle: Research and Application of 110 kV C4-FN Mixtures Gas-insulated Switchgear (GIS)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) gas is widely used in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) because of its excellent properties for insulation. However, SF6 gas has a high global warming potential (GWP) value and has a negative impact on the environment. In order to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, SF6 gas is replaced by C4- FN mixtures. The material properties,and properties for insulation of C4- FN mixtures are analyzed, and the GWP value of C4-FN mixtures is much lower than that of SF6 gas,and the carbon emission of C4-FN mixtures high-voltage equipment is also lower than SF6, and it has excellent properties for insulation and arc interruption, C4-FN mixtures GIS has been applied in the 110kV interval expansion project of a 110kV substation in Shanghai, which verifies the reliability and environmental protection of the equipment, and fills the blank of the engineering application of C4-FN mixtures in high-voltage equipment in China.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Allocation Methods for Low-Carbon Operation of Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper discusses the cost modelling of energy storage configurations in distribution networks to meet carbon reduction targets. Key factors such as capacity cost (investment per kWh) and power cost (investment per kW) are examined, and a formula for calculating the average daily investment cost over the system life cycle is presented. A case study using wind turbines and photovoltaic (PV) installations in an IEEE 33-node distribution system aims to minimise daily operating costs, carbon emissions, and peak-to-valley arbitrage. Optimisation was performed using the Gurobi solver in MATLAB 2022, assuming energy storage costs of RMB 1.5 million per MWh and RMB 1 million per MW. The study's objective function includes carbon emission cost, energy storage allocation cost, and peak-valley arbitrage benefit. The paper demonstrates the cost-benefit trade-offs through optimisation, providing valuable insights into the design and optimisation of future distribution networks.

articleTitle: Study on photovoltaic and Energy Storage Locating and Sizing for Distribution Network Based on Multi-Objective Non-Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As more and more people use small-scale power generation, improving solar power technology is very important for changing the distribution network. To use solar power effectively, we need to address the issues of where to place solar panels and how much power they can connect to the electricity network along with storage systems. Therefore, a new way is suggested to improve how we choose locations and set up solar panels and storage in the electricity distribution system. First, using a non-collaborative game theory method, a streamlined approach has been formulated for determining ideal locations and managing the capacity of solar energy and storage systems within a power distribution network. Then, the Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization(IMOPSO) algorithm was used to solve the problem. The use of a Pareto solution in IMOPSO aids in discovering the ideal solution tailored to each individual optimal. The global optimal solution is found through the entropy weight TOPSIS method. Finally, the IEEE 33-buses power distribution system is used as an example for simulation verification. The results indicate that the method suggested in this paper works well for finding the best locations and sizes for energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Joint Planning Method for Energy Storage System and Soft Open Point in Distribution Networks Considering Carbon Emission Reduction Allocation and Cluster Division Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An energy storage system and soft open point configuration approach considering the allocation of carbon emission reduction income and cluster division strategy is proposed to solve the problem of the mismatch between the absorption capacity and growth rate of the system caused by a large-scale access of distributed renewable energy sources to the distribution network. Firstly, all nodes are divided into several cluster regions based on the electrical distance and its power and load characteristics. Secondly, based on the improved calculation model of node carbon emission flow rate, an evaluation model is proposed to calculate the influence which energy storage system and soft open point have on the carbon emission flow of the distribution network and the carbon emission reduction apportionment of energy storage to each user. Then, a joint planning method of energy storage system and soft open point is proposed to minimize the cost of energy storage life cycle and maximize the benefits of carbon emission reduction. Finally, based on a simulation example of the IEEE 33 node distribution network, this paper verifies the correctness of the improved carbon flow calculation method and the validity and economy of the cluster division and energy storage system configuration method.

articleTitle: Power System Damage Assessment Considering Cascading Failures Under the E1 HEMP
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) has the characteristics of high peak value, wide coverage and wide spectrum, which can effectively couple conductor cables, causing damage to secondary equipment such as control, protection and communication equipment, and primary equipment such as transformers, insulators and circuit breakers. Meanwhile, as a large number of components are removed from operation, the power flow transfer will further expand the scope of faults and form cascading failures, which will bring great impact to the grid. This paper combines existing research to analyze the equipment failure mechanism and establish a cascading failures model that considers the influence of communication equipment. Finally, the impact of the El HEMP is analyzed by means of a public case. The results show that HEMP El has a huge impact on the grid, while the visibility and controllability of power system play an important role in defending against the pulse threat..

articleTitle: Research on Inertial Optimization Control of PV-Storage DC Microgrid Based on Model Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Affected by the integration of distributed power sources such as photovoltaics, the low inertia characteristics of DC microgrids are gradually becoming apparent. When there are significant changes in the output and load of distributed power sources, the bus voltage is prone to significant fluctuations, even affecting system stability. A current feedforward control strategy based on Analog Virtual Synchronous Generators (AVSG) optimization is proposed for this purpose. Firstly, a small signal model is established for the control of AVSG based on energy storage inverters. The role of the virtual inertia coefficient in the voltage dynamic process has been elucidated, and the problems of current feedforward in AVSG control are analyzed. Secondly, in response to the weak improvement effect of voltage dynamic performance under AVSG control, based on the overcompensation problem of current feedforward compensation, a feedforward optimization method based on predictive models is proposed, which effectively improves the voltage fluctuations caused by distributed power generation output and load changes, and enhances the dynamic performance of DC microgrids and the inertial control effect of AVSG. Finally, the efficacy of the proposed control strategy was confirmed via MATLAB/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Strategy for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Soft Actor-Critic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric vehicles are emerged as a promising clean energy transportation solution. However, a massive deployment of EVs tends to create new technical challenges for modern power systems, such as the orderly dispatch of EVs charging. To this end, this paper develops an optimal dispatching method for electric vehicles charging station to maximize its own profit as well as enhance the stability of distribution networks. Moreover, an enhanced deep reinforcement learning based method call soft actor-critic is utilized to deal with the optimization problem and obtain the optimal dispatching strategy. The experiment results illustrate that the proposed method can significantly maximize the charging station's profit.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Active and Reactive Power Joint Optimization of Hydrogen-Containing Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The burgeoning proliferation of renewable energy sources presents significant challenges for the operational management of active distribution networks, chiefly concerning the economical and secure management of distributed power output uncertainties. Concurrently, the increasing adoption of hydrogen energy within distribution networks, owing to its environmental advantages, underscores the need for effective solutions. Addressing the aforementioned challenges within hydrogen-containing active distribution network, this study proposes a comprehensive approach centered on multi-time scale optimization of active and reactive power. This approach comprises two key components: day-ahead scheduling and intra-day correction, aimed at mitigating the intermittency of renewable energy and minimizing the impact of prediction errors on network operation. Furthermore, leveraging insights into the coupling dynamics between active and reactive power within distribution networks and the flexible control capabilities inherent to hydrogen-based equipment, the proposed methodology facilitates the optimization of network losses through coordinated active and reactive power management. Consequently, this not only maximizes operational benefits but also ensures the safe functioning of active distribution networks. The efficacy and viability of the proposed methodology are demonstrated through rigorous simulation analyses and computational assessments.

Author Keywords: coordinated scheduling of active and reactive power

articleTitle: Research on Grid-Connected and Off-Grid Smooth Switching Strategy of PMSG Converter Based on Grid Forming Control
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Grid-forming converters can operate synchronously with power grid and stably in islanding mode when disconnected from the grid. How to maintain voltage and frequency stability, reduce current surges, and ensure the continuity and reliability of power supply during mode switching is a key issue that urgently needs to be addressed of wind power. To improve the transient stability of the switching process, this paper dynamically adjusts the inverter reference power, reducing voltage and current surges effectively during the switching process. Finally, a Hardware-in-the-Loop platform was built using RT-LAB and RTU-BOX, and the results of the smooth switching between gird-connected and off-grid strategy for the grid-forming converter based on PMSG were verified effectively.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Platform Architecture and Typical Scenario of Distribution Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale of the distribution Internet of Things and the increase of complex data volume, the traditional simulation method has been unable to meet the simulation needs of the current distribution network. In this paper, the key technology of large-scale physical cyber hybrid integrated simulation is proposed, and on this basis, the physical cyber interactive simulation platform is developed to realize the digital twin of distribution Internet of things.

articleTitle: Seamless Low-Voltage Ride-Through Control for Grid-Forming Inverter Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The grid-forming converter should have low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) capability. A seamless low-voltage ride-through control method for inverters based on the grid-forming virtual synchronous generator (VSG) is proposed in this paper. The method includes a synchronous compensation controller to ensure the inverter output voltage is always synchronized with the grid voltage. When the grid voltage dips below the threshold, the VSG control of the grid-connected inverter seamlessly switches to the low voltage ride through control, with the synchronous compensation controller enabled. When the grid voltage recovers, the control reverts to VSG control and deactivates the synchronous compensation controller after the transient state ends. This method ensures that the output voltage of the grid-connected inverter is always synchronized with the grid voltage during control mode changes. The presented simulation results validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: State Estimation for Low-Voltage Distribution System with High Proportion Distributed Energy Resource based on Invariant Risk Minimization
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Accurate perception of low-voltage distribution system state is critical for the control and operation of power grids. Recently, learning-based state estimation methods have been seriously challenged by the data shift induced by a high proportion of distributed energy resources. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved learning-based low-voltage distribution system state estimation method. Firstly, a state estimation model for the low-voltage distribution system based on an adaptive neural network is established by utilizing the historical data of smart meters. Then, to eliminate the effects of data shift, a state estimation accuracy improvement method based on invariant risk minimization is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in the actual distribution network.

articleTitle: Graph Convolutional Network-Based Federated Learning Method for Distribution System Topology Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution system topology identification is the basic function for system operation but is hindered by data privacy concerns and uncertainties arising from high penetration of renewable energy sources (RES). To tackle these issues, a graph convolutional network-based federated learning method (GraphFed) is proposed for topology identification while ensuring data privacy. Specifically, to remove the data leakage risk, the federated learning (FL) algorihm is proposed for topology identification in a decentralized learning framework. Besides, the proposed graph convolutional network (GCN) leverages a novel node embedding-based graph shift operator to automatically represent the graphical features of the power system data to achieve enhanced topology identification accuracy. Comparative experiments are conducted on the IEEE 33-node distribution system, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed GraphFed method.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Energy Disaggregation Using the Seq2point Method Based on CNN-LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of deep learning into Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) technologies has spurred significant advancements in the precision of load identification and power disaggregation. Despite these gains, several hurdles remain, such as low accuracy in decomposing multi-state electrical loads, suboptimal generalizability of algorithms, and lengthy processing times. To tackle these challenges, we present a seq2point load decomposition model that combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks. This model traverses sequences of total power data to pinpoint the power consumption of target devices within specific intervals of the power data.
