Our approach begins by employing a sliding window-based event detection mechanism to isolate active load instances, which then serve as inputs for the seq2point model. Using CNNs, the model autonomously extracts local features from the aggregated power data. Additionally, LSTMs are utilized to analyze temporal correlations surrounding each point in the sequence, improving the accuracy of load identification. To evaluate the effectiveness of our model, we applied it to a real-world domestic energy dataset, UKDALE, and compared its performance against leading models. The results demonstrated a substantial improvement of 18.4% in overall performance, confirming the significant enhancement in load monitoring capabilities achieved by our deep learning approach. These findings underscore the potential of combining CNNs and LSTMs to effectively manage the complexities involved in load decomposition, especially in scenarios characterized by intricate and fluctuating power consumption patterns.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method of Fault Ranging Scheme for Medium Voltage Distribution Grid Based on Combined Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is not easy to trade-off the ranging accuracy and economy when different ranging methods are applied in distribution networks, this paper proposes a fault ranging scheme optimization method based on the combination assignment for medium voltage distribution networks. First, an evaluation system for fault ranging schemes is established from six perspectives: increased reliability of power supply, increased rate of IDG consumption, social (economic) benefits, benefits for power supply companies, communications dependency and time dependency. Then, the combined assignment method and solution method based on FAHP method and CRITIC method are proposed; Finally, the proposed method is verified to be concise, clear and feasible by taking an example of a 10KV distribution network and three typical ranging schemes in a certain area.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Buck-Boost Characteristics of 10kV AC PP Cable Based on Typical Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Polypropylene (PP) cable has become a research hotspot for insulated cables due to its good thermoplastic properties and recyclability. By preparing defective sections of PP cables with different defects and building a cable partial discharge (PD) pressure test platform, the defective sections of PP cables with defects were tested by step-up and step-down tests. The PD data of PP cables with different defects at different voltage levels were collected and analyzed. The pulse repetition rate (PRR) and pulse amplitude variation of the PP cable are positively correlated with the voltage level, and only the PRR characteristics of the circumcision cutting knife mark defect are opposite. The test data shows that the pulse amplitude during the voltage reduction process is smaller than that during the voltage increase process, and the partial discharge inception voltage (PDIV) is usually smaller than partial discharge extinction voltage (PDEV), indicating that the extinction phenomenon of PD is more likely to occur than its occurrence, except for the opposite characteristic of metal particle defects.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization Scheme of Under-Voltage Load Shedding
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There have been multiple large-scale power outages caused by voltage instability internationally since the 1970s. Under-voltage load shedding has been widely applied in power systems as an emergency control measure in the third line of defense against power system collapse. Currently, there are two commonly used control schemes: distributed control scheme and centralized control scheme. The former is widely used domestically, while both are used abroad. This paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the two control schemes in detail, points out the risks of incorrect operation or failure to operate under special operating conditions, and proposes an optimized scheme and demonstrates the implement solution.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Fault Diagnosis and Isolation Recovery Algorithm for High Load Density Urban Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution network in the urban downtown area of Shanghai has the characteristics of high load density and serves many important consumers. The 10 kV distribution network has the most times of faults in full voltage level of power grid, which has a great impact on reliability. In order to ensure a safe and stable operation, this paper presents an autonomous fault monitoring, diagnosis and isolation recovery algorithm for distribution network in high load density downtown area. Firstly, the grid graph theory model is constructed to realize a fast fault location and the division of minimum outage area. Then the load transfer switch set and switch action sequence are generated to ensure a quick recovery of power supply in non-fault areas. Finally, simulation is built to based on an actual case for demonstration. The proposed algorithm can accurately locate faults and provide optimal power supply path, which greatly reduces the affected number of households during power outage. This can also contribute to a resilient distribution network.

articleTitle: Flexible Interconnection Control Strategy of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Unified Power Quality Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the advancement of society and economy, the electricity load on the user side has seen a significant increase. Some Low-Voltage (LV) distribution areas are grappling with severe load inequality issues, while traditional Flexible Interconnected Devices (FID) like Soft Open Points (SOP) face challenges in the LV distribution field due to their high cost and limited functionality. To address this situation, this paper proposes a flexible interconnection control strategy for LV distribution areas based on the topology of the Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC). The objective is to enable power interconnection between stations. The control strategy utilizes Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) output control signals to reduce the required converter capacity for regulating power flow. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of this control strategy under various scenarios, such as load casting, switching, and expectation changes, are verified through simulations.

articleTitle: A CBL Estimation Method for Industrial Customers Based on K-Means and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In pursuit of attaining the objective of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality”, the structure of energy in China has undergone a great transformation. With the rapid development of renewable energy generation, the power grid has been confronted with new challenges. The reliability and flexibility of the grid have been affected. Demand response (DR), as an effective management method, has become a hotspot. Customer baseline load (CBL) serves as the standard for calculating economic compensation in DR. Hence, accurate estimation of CBL is a crucial aspect in ensuring the effective implementation of DR strategies. This paper proposes a CBL estimation method for industrial customers based on the K-means and long short-term memory (LSTM). First, the K-means method is used to cluster the daily load curves of various industries to yield the typical patterns of electricity consumption behaviors. Second, the LSTM neural network is established to estimate CBL. It is trained with historical load data of different industries and clustering results. Finally, the effectiveness of the novel method is validated via a real data set.

articleTitle: Voltage Coordination Control of Photovoltaic Storage Clusters in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution network in northwest China has the characteristics of long lines and obvious load peaks and valleys. With the continuous increase in the number of distributed photovoltaic (PV) connections, it is prone to the problem of high PV output during the day and lower line voltage when the load becomes heavier at night. In order to enhance the regulation capability of the distribution network when the voltage exceeds the limit in this situation, this paper proposes a voltage control strategy based on the coordination regulation of PV storage clusters. Firstly, a comprehensive cost control objective for intra cluster regulation was proposed, taking into account the charging and discharging costs, PV's abandonment costs, and line network losses during the energy storage (ES) life cycle. Based on cluster network separation and second-order cone relaxation (SOCR), an optimal power flow calculation model was established within the cluster to achieve optimized control. Secondly, based on the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM), cluster boundary data exchange rules and control objectives with boundary variable constraints are established. Through iterative data exchange, optimal control between clusters is achieved, thereby achieving global optimal regulation of PV and ES. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method were verified through simulation using the IEEE33 node system.

articleTitle: General Visual Prior Integrated YOLOv8 for Accurate Insulator Detection of Power Distribution Networks in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Detecting distribution network insulators with deep learning algorithms is challenging due to the complex background and the small size of the targets. Since Visual Foundation Models(VFM) have shown impressive performance in general domains, this paper attempts to utilize the features extracted from VFM to assist YOLOv8 in achieving more accurate detection. InternImage is selected to provide the general visual priors, and its features are combined with the feature maps of YOLOv8 after passing through a feature fusion block. The proposed model is evaluated through extensive experiments by training on the distribution network insulator dataset and demonstrated to be superior to the original YOLOv8 in this task. Further, the superiority of the proposed model in detecting small-size insulators is illustrated by visualization. Additionally, the effectiveness of the proposed solution in identifying small-size insulators is demonstrated through visualization.

articleTitle: A Permanent Fault Identification Method for Distribution Networks Based on Sequential Reclosing
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that blind reclosing to permanent faults will bring secondary impacts to the distribution network, a permanent fault identification method for distribution network based on sequential reclosing is proposed. Firstly, the analysis model of using a phase segregated switch in distribution network is established. The expressions of active power of reclosing phase under temporary and permanent faults with different neutral grounding modes are derived, and the difference of active power for different fault properties is obtained. Secondly, the criterion of permanent fault identification based on active power is constructed. The influence of transition resistance, load capacity and other factors is analyzed. Finally, the reclosing strategy is proposed. PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results verify that the theoretical analysis is correct, and the proposed permanent fault identification method is highly sensitive.

articleTitle: Power Quality Control and Multi-Objective Optimization Compensation Strategy for Grid-Connected Multi-Functional Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To better utilize the residual capacity of grid-connected inverters and improve the power quality of distribution substations, this paper investigates a control strategy for a multi-functional grid-connected inverter with power quality control capabilities. Compared with traditional grid-connected inverters, the proposed multifunctional inverter introduces the control concept of an active filter based on grid-connected power generation. Through the harmonic detection stage, compensating currents are added to the inverter's output to counteract the harmonics and reactive current components generated by the load. Subsequently, based on the Catastrophe Theory, a comprehensive power quality assessment method based on is adopted to evaluate the power quality of the microgrid comprehensively. Finally, a multi-objective optimization compensation strategy is proposed. The reference current for the multifunctional grid-connected inverter is optimized using a multi-objective particle swarm algorithm, balancing the effectiveness of power quality management and the minimization of compensation capacity. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve the optimal compensation strategy for the inverter while meeting the comprehensive power quality indicators, thereby significantly enhancing the performance of the grid-connected inverter.

articleTitle: Seamless Switching Technology for Low Voltage Charging in 800V Electric Vehicle Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In response to the high voltage stress issue in the secondary components of the DC/DC converter caused by increasing the electric vehicle charging system from 400V to 800V, a low-voltage seamless charging switching technique is proposed. Building upon the optimized design of the 400V DC/DC converter, this technique utilizes the Battery Selection Circuit (BSC) to enable charging of 800V high-voltage batteries. The topology is described, along with a simple modulation scheme, providing a detailed explanation of how the BSC circuit achieves seamless and dead-time-free charging for two 400V batteries. This enhances the reliability of the converter, reducing grid load fluctuations caused by a large number of electric vehicles charging. The lower voltage stress on the converter components and the separate design of the BSC circuit's switching frequency result in overall lower losses and improved efficiency and energy utilization on the load side of the system. Finally, an experimental prototype is built to further validate the feasibility of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Tampering Method of Convolutional Coding for Power Internet of Things Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of Internet of Things technology, traditional power grids are gradually integrating with the Internet of Things to form the power Internet of Things, greatly improving the level of informatisation and intelligence. The terminal sensors in the perception layer of the power Internet of Things cannot apply complex security technologies due to device performance limitations, thus facing information security risks. This paper proposes a data tamper proof method for power IoT sensors based on convolutional encoding and decoding. This method can recover erroneous data to correct data when transmission information is disturbed and errors occur. Moreover, terminal devices of the power Internet of Things are usually embedded systems, and the communication, storage, and computing capabilities of the devices are limited to a certain extent. Convolutional codes have lower algorithm complexity and less computational overhead, and can adapt to most scenarios.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Fault Crossing of Three-phase Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The proposed goal of “double carbon” in China has attracted much attention from new energy generation. However, the new energy generation has intermittency, volatility and other characteristics to the stability of the grid has brought a certain challenge. Therefore, many new energy distribution and storage schemes have been introduced, so the stable operation of the energy storage system after grid connection is particularly critical. Based on the time domain simulation of PSCAD/ EMTDC three-phase energy storage system, this paper studies whether the system has the ability of stable fault crossing during the fault period.

articleTitle: Energy Scheduling of Wind-Solar Integrated Hydrogen Production System Based on Wind Solar Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Hydrogen production from renewable sources is an efficient way to promote renewable sources consumption. In order to suppress the impact of source uncertainty on system scheduling, and improve the system efficiency, a two-stage energy scheduling strategy consisting of two-stage rolling optimization scheduling for a wind-solar integrated hydrogen production system is proposed. In the day-ahead stage, a day-ahead optimization scheduling model is established with the objectives of system operating cost and hydrogen production revenue based on long-term power forecasting. In the intra-day stage, an intra-day rolling optimization scheduling strategy with a day-ahead cost function and energy storage SOC penalty as the basis is established based on short-term power forecasting. Case study verified that the impact of source uncertainty on system energy scheduling can be suppressed with the proposed scheduling strategy, thereby improving system hydrogen production revenue.

articleTitle: Automatic Completion Method of Power Missing Data in Distribution Network Based on GCN-VAE Model
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the expansion of distribution network and extensive information collection, some data are missing due to interference in data collection and transmission, so it is urgent to realize effective data completion. This paper presents a novel approach for completing missing power data using a combination of graph convolution neural network (GCN) and variational self-encoder (VAE). Firstly, the power data is passed through GCN, and the spatial characteristics are learned from the original data, so as to obtain the spatial dependence. Then, the data is reconstructed through VAE, and the network parameters are constantly updated by calculating the loss function value during training. Using the two-way algorithm model of GCN-VAE, the forward completion data and reverse completion data of time series are weighted, and the missing data is automatically completed. The experimental results indicate that the GCN-VAE-based completion model achieves higher accuracy compared to traditional data completion methods.

articleTitle: Electric Power Dispatch Instruction Generation Method Based on Sequence-to-Sequence Model
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In view of the fact that the existing power dispatch instruction generation methods are difficult to meet the accuracy requirements in the actual application of distribution networks, this paper proposes a method for generating electric power dispatching instructions based on a sequence-to-sequence model (Seq2Seq). This method uses a long short-term memory network (LSTM) to build an Encoder-Decoder structure, and adds an attention mechanism and a beam search algorithm in the decoding process. The comparative experiment shows that the Encoder-Decoder structure model proposed in this paper improves the F1 score by 7.14% and 10.37% respectively compared with the similar models built by double-layer and single-layer recurrent neural networks (RNN). The ablation experiment further verifies the effectiveness of adding the attention mechanism and the beam search algorithm in the decoding process for generating electric power dispatching instructions.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Optimal Planning and Scheduling Model for Energy Storage Systems in the Market Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, energy storage systems (ESS) have grown rapidly due to their advantages of flexible configuration, fast response speed, combined charging and discharging capabilities. In addition, it has been clearly stated both domestically and internationally that ESS can participate in the electricity market as an independent entity. Therefore, a bi-level optimal planning and scheduling model for ESS in the market environment is proposed. The upper-level model is the ESS's daily revenue model while taking into account its investment cost. The lower-level model is the electricity market clearing model. Then, the solution method for the bi-level model is introduced. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed planning and scheduling model for ESS.

articleTitle: A Novel Inductor-Based Active Battery Equalization Circuit and Group Balancing Strategy for Battery Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the load on power grids increases and the rise in renewable energy generation, the task of matching load and generation becomes increasingly challenging. Battery Storage Systems playing a crucial role in support distribution networks. However, inconsistencies among individual batteries can affect battery lifespan, increase storage costs, and pose safety risks. This paper proposes a novel battery equalization circuit based on inductors, which maintains the inductor current by utilizing the freewheeling diode of the MOSFET and the current discharge path during faults, thereby simplifying the design. Adjacent batteries share a set ofMOSFETs, which significantly reducing circuit costs. Additionally, the circuit can equalize adjacent batteries simultaneously, improving equalization speed. The proposed circuit and strategy are validated through theoretical analysis and simulation, demonstrating their effectiveness in achieving rapid and efficient battery equalization.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Transient Analysis Method for DC Lines Considering Multiple Refractions and Reflections of Traveling Waves
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A precise transient electrical quantity analysis method for DC line faults is an important basis for protection setting adjustment and power equipment parameter design. However, the transient process of faults in DC transmission systems is complex, and the analytical calculation is difficult. Most of the existing analysis methods can only analyze the fault electrical quantities during the initial traveling wave (TM) stage. Based on the traditional initial TW fault analysis method, this paper analyzes the multiple refractions and reflections of TWs after the line fault, and proposes an analytical calculation method for the entire fault process electrical quantities without increasing the calculation matrix dimension. Through simulation tests, the accuracy of the proposed algorithm is fully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research and Application of User-Side Optical Storage Optimization Operation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of China's carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals, numerous distributed generations such as photovoltaic and energy storage are being deployed on the user side. This study addresses the challenges of optimizing operational scheduling to enhance economic benefits and elevate user satisfaction levels. This paper uses Quantum-behaved Particle Swarm Optimization (QPSO) algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters and network topology of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Consequently, a QPSO-LSTM short-term load prediction model was developed alongside an optimization scheduling model for user micro grids, which was solved using the CPLEX solver. The proposed model effectively integrates photovoltaic and energy storage resources to optimize micro grid operation. The results indicate that this optimal scheduling method not only ensures stable micro grid operation but also reduces power consumption on the user side and enhances user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Study on Centralized PCCVF Method for Multi-Band Resonance of New Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the presence of a weak grid, the resonance of the power grid could impact the stability of the LCL filter grid-connected inverter, their performance can become worse, because the resonant frequency is affected by changes in the grid impedance, resulting in an unstable region. Therefore, it is necessary to design the control system to deal with these problems. In this paper, a simple and robust method based on voltage feedforward at a point of common coupling (PCC) was adopted, which achieved the purpose of reducing the cost investment, The strategy was applied to only one of the grid-connected inverters. The results demonstrated that the system's stability was ensured, as the proposed scheme did not affect the phase margin of the system. In order to verify whether the harmonic radiation can be suppressed by the proposed strategy, a grid-connected inverter system operating in single-phase was simulated and tested.

Author Keywords: Point of Co-m mon Coupling (PCC) voltage feedforward

articleTitle: Plug and Play Wireless Intelligent Temperature Sensing Device and Status Evaluation for Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A wireless temperature sensing device with a fast installation structure for distribution transformers is proposed in this paper. The device adopts wireless surface acoustic wave technology and differential structure design. In order to prevent device detection circuit failure or degradation, a method based on indirect standard source is proposed for calibrating the circuit error. At the same time, in order to improve the accuracy of frequency estimation for sensor feedback signals, frequency estimation algorithm based on singular value decomposition of feedback signals is carried out. By taking into account key factors such as current, temperature, three-phase imbalance, and equipment service life, combined with the historical operating status of the equipment. A scoring method is adopted to comprehensively evaluate the working status of the distribution transformer. Through testing and on-site practical application, it has proved that the intelligent temperature sensing device for distribution transformers can effectively monitor the temperature of transformer joints and upload monitoring data and assessing results to the distribution IoT management platform.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Coping Strategy of Power Distribution Network Considering the Uncertainty of Source and Load
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With a large number of distributed generator (DG) connected to the distribution network, the uncertainty of source and load increases the risk of safe operation of the distribution network. Therefore, a risk response strategy for distribution network is proposed. Firstly, the probability distribution model of source and load is established, and the three-point estimation method is used to calculate the probability density function of node voltage and line power. Secondly, the comprehensive risk index of node voltage over-limit and the comprehensive risk index of line power overload are established, and the risk value is calculated. Then, the voltage over-limit risk of the node is reduced by adjusting the active power resources and the military power resources. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed risk response strategy is verified by the CPS62 node example.

articleTitle: Active Distribution Network Reactive and Active Synergistic Optimization Scheduling Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of network overvoltage, exacerbated voltage fluctuations, frequent tap changer operations of the step voltage regulator, and wrong operation of distribution network protection caused by distributed photovoltaic access to the distribution network, considering the active and reactive power coupling characteristics in the actual active distribution network, an active and reactive power coordinated dispatch system for the distribution network is established. The inverter is responsible only for mitigating the voltage fluctuations caused by the sharp changes in output, significantly reducing the reactive compensation burden and capacity of the photovoltaic inverter. This can extend the equipment lifespan of the inverter and reduce investment costs, while ensuring the safe operation of the distribution network and further maximizing operational benefits. The effectiveness of the model is verified through practical cases. The results show that the local voltage control method based on real-time reactive compensation can save line losses to a certain extent compared to the traditional reactive power - active power droop curve method.

articleTitle: Flexible Expansion Planning of Power Grid Considering Inter-Regional Spatio-Temporal Transferable Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The uncertainty brought by large-scale integration of renew-able energy into the grid poses challenges to power system planning and stable operation. To address this issue, further utilization of flexible demand resources is needed, including Internet Data Centers (IDCs) and Electric Vehicles (EVs) with spatio-temporal flexibility. This paper proposes a flexi-ble planning bi-level model considering the spatio-temporal transferability of IDCs and EVs. The upper level is a multi-objective flexible planning layer, while the lower level is a scheduling layer considering spatio-temporal transferability. Simulation results demonstrate that leveraging the spatio-temporal transferability of demand-side resources can opti-mize power flow distribution, reduce the number of pending power grid constructions, lower investment costs in the pow-er system, shift peak loads, and alleviate potential grid con-gestion.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy for Under Frequency Load Shedding in Isolated Microgrids Under Extreme Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When a fault occurs in the distribution network, the microgrid will form unplanned islanding conditions, resulting in load shortages and frequency drops. A under frequency load shedding strategy for islanded microgrids under extreme operating conditions is proposed to address this issue. Firstly, based on the importance of load, establish a microgrid node load classification model. Secondly, considering the frequency characteristics of loads and the economic losses of load shedding, a under frequency load shedding strategy for classified loads in isolated microgrids is formulated to restore system frequency, and optimization algorithms are used to obtain the optimal execution action. The final simulation results through numerical examples show that the proposed algorithm can quickly reduce the load plan and restore the frequency, verifying the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed unplanned islanding under frequency load reduction strategy for microgrids.

articleTitle: Engineering Design of Triangle-Connected High-Voltage Cascaded Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To accelerate the development of renewable energy sources, China plans to construct over 450 million kilowatts of renewable energy capacity in desert areas during the 14th and 15th Five-Year Plans. With the evolving power grid, energy storage systems face heightened demands in terms of energy conversion efficiency, power capacity, and other aspects. The high-voltage cascaded energy storage system has emerged as a promising solution, offering advantages such as high cycle efficiency and substantial individual capacity. This article focuses on the design of a triangle-connected high-voltage cascaded battery energy storage system. It covers aspects such as battery installed capacity, topology structure, and equipment parameters. Finally, a simulation model based on engineering case is developed to validate the correctness of the engineering design.

articleTitle: Analysis of Neutral Point Voltage Characteristics in Small Resistance Grounded System with Single-Phase Line Break Faults in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, line break faults in distribution networks have become increasingly common. This paper focuses on small resistance grounded systems, analyzing the characteristics of neutral point voltage shifts under different conditions of fallen conductors following a line break. The study considers various fault factors, including fault location, grounding resistance, and load impedance, and investigates three scenarios: line break without grounding, line break with grounding on the power supply side, and line break with grounding on the load side. The research finds that in all three cases, the amplitude of the neutral point voltage is primarily influenced by the grounding resistance-the larger the grounding resistance, the greater the amplitude of the neutral point voltage. Finally, a model of a small resistance grounded system with a single-phase line break fault was built using MATLAB/Simulink simulation software, which confirmed the accuracy of the analyzed results.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Decision Making for Distributed Photovoltaic Optimization Operation Based on Optimal Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The combined decision-making method based on SOCR and CNN was established to address the problems of power flow backflow, increased network losses, and voltage exceeding caused by large-scale grid connection of distributed photovoltaics. Firstly, establish an optimal power flow model with the objective functions of minimizing grid loss and maximizing photovoltaic consumption. Secondly, constraints were established and OPF was transformed into a SOCP model, which was solved using the CPLEX solver, the effectiveness of the model was verified through simulation. Finally, the deep learning algorithms are introduced to train historical operational data, construct mapping relationships between load, photovoltaic and operational plans, and combine them with OPF models for combination decision-making. This method can continuously improve decision-making efficiency and has good performance in practical use.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Operation and Risk Management Under the Background of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the transformation of energy structure and the continuous growth of power demand, the development of new power system is being paid more and more attention. Under the background of the new power system, the operation and risk management of the digital intelligent distribution network have become the key link to improve the operation efficiency of the power system and ensure the security of energy supply. This paper expounds the application path, modeling and analysis method of the digital intelligent distribution network in the new power system, as well as the results achieved in the actual operation, aiming to provide theoretical support and practical guidance for the operation and risk management of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis and Enhancement Strategy of Hybrid-converter System of Grid-Following and Grid-Forming
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the transient stability analysis of a hybrid-converter system with paralleled grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) control is conducted, followed by the design of a stability-improvement strategy. Firstly, the network model of the hybrid-converter system is formulated, grounded in its control characteristics. Secondly, using the node current law and the equal area criterion (EAC) method, the system's transient stability under grid fault is analyzed, focusing on the influence exerted by the power angle interactions between GFL and GFM converters. Following this, an added control strategy is introduced, aimed at enhancing the transient stability by regulating the power angle difference. At last, simulation outcomes are presented to substantiate the efficacy of the introduced strategy.

articleTitle: DC-link Oscillation Suppression For DAB-based Photovoltaic- Energy Storage Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the photovoltaic (PV)-energy storage system, the dc-link oscillation is usually generated due to the interactions between converters. This paper takes the dual-active bridge (DAB) converter integrating energy storage as the research object of the suppression. Based on the small-signal model of DAB converter, an active damping using capacitance voltage feedforward is proposed to simulate resistor and capacitor respectively on demand, thus reshaping the input impedance of the DAB converter. Finally, the strategy is validated by impedance modeling and the electromagnetic transient simulation.

articleTitle: Two-Layer Optimization of Active Distribution Network Based on Electric Vehicle Incentive Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the gradual implementation of the “dual carbon” target policy, traditional fuel vehicles are transitioning to electric vehicles. Simultaneously, there has been substantial growth in new energy generation technologies and the proliferation of electric vehicles, leading to a significant increase in distributed power sources connected to active distribution networks. Active distribution networks have become a focal point in today's power systems due to these developments and are seen as a future trend in grid development. Therefore, effectively managing the integration of these new energy sources into the grid is crucial for ensuring safe and reliable voltage operation. To address challenges such as the impact of unregulated charging of electric vehicles on the distribution network's peak and valley load differentials, this paper proposes a dual-layer optimization strategy. This strategy integrates economic dispatch optimization and reactive power optimization of the distribution network, considering both the network's economic efficiency and security. The simulation utilizes a second-order cone algorithm and employs the IEEE 33-node system as a basis to construct and analyze three distinct scenarios for comparative evaluation. Key metrics such as distribution network losses and voltage quality are examined to validate the proposed model's effectiveness and the algorithm's capability in solving the dual-layer optimization. The findings provide theoretical support for optimal distribution network scheduling, demonstrating the rationale and effectiveness of the proposed model and its associated algorithm. This research contributes to advancing the understanding and practical application of managing active distribution networks amidst the increasing integration of electric vehicles and renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Efficiency Enhanced Burst Mode Control Strategy for Microinverters
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the trend of renewable energy, photovoltaic (PV) inverters are widely used around the world. Inverter's efficiency significantly decreases at low input power, and microinverters spend a significant percentage of the year operating at that case. Achieving high conversion efficiency is the key to improving total efficiency. A burst mode parameter design method is proposed in this paper, which aims to improve efficiency by designing the burst mode's upper bound voltage and switching case based on tradeoff between inverter efficiency and maximum power point tracking (MPPT) efficiency. Then, a simple MPPT strategy for burst mode is implemented. Finally, experimental tests are performed, verifying the efficiency improvements of proposed strategy. The experimental results show that the proposed strategy achieves a combined efficiency of 92.53%, which allows more solar power to be available to the users and the grid.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle Charging Trade Strategy Based on Digital Twin and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the scale of electric vehicles increases, the cloud computing trade centers will bear significant operational pressure. The edge computing technology can process charging data and identify potential fault risks of electric vehicles which can reduce the operational load of electric vehicle cloud computing centers. The digital twin model can reflect the entire life cycle process of electric vehicle physical equipment which can predict charging facilities, vehicle status and energy demand. The fuzzy neural network can be used to predict the trend of electric vehicle charging trade. The participation of electric vehicles in spot market quotations can effectively guide various trading entities to adjust their resource distribution. By the interaction between physical system and digital twin system, the charging resources can be allocated reasonably which can improve their utilization rate.

articleTitle: Breakdown Characteristics and Electrical Life Time Evaluation of 525 kV EHVDC Cable Insulation at Different Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The extensive deployment of remote offshore wind power has gained considerable traction, wherein cross-linked polyethylene(XLPE) cables are preferred for their benefits, including straightforward structure, significant transmission capacity, and high temperature resistance. However, due to the harsh environment and operating conditions of submarine cable laying, the safe operation of HVDC submarine cables faces serious challenges. Hence, it is imperative to undertake studies focused on the breakdown properties and life index of ±525 kV DC submarine cables at different temperatures and thicknesses, in order to provide support for promoting the development of long-distance and high-capacity power transmission at sea. DC breakdown, impulse voltage breakdown, and DC step-stress tests were carried out on samples of different temperatures and thicknesses. The results indicate that as the temperature increases, The sample's DC breakdown strength and impulse voltage breakdown strength exhibit a declining trend, and an inverse power law describes the functional link between breakdown strength and thickness. The breakdown characteristics and electrical aging life index of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 525$</tex> kV DC submarine cables were obtained through DC breakdown, impact breakdown, and gradient withstand voltage tests. The insulation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 525$</tex> kV DC underwater cables has aging life indices of 22, 20, 15, and 13 at 30, 50, 70, and 90°C, respectively. The test findings can offer support for the design of insulation structure and the lifespan evaluation of high-voltage direct current (HVDC) submarine cables.

articleTitle: Design Method of Intelligent Substation Configuration File Security Control System Based on AOP and MVC Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A smart substation configuration file security control system based on AOP and MVC structures is proposed to address the issue of close coupling between traditional intelligent substation configuration file security logic and business logic, resulting in complex and difficult to maintain systems. Firstly, an analysis was conducted on the configuration file process, lifecycle process, and control technology within the intelligent substation. Then, based on this, the design models of AOP structure and MVC structure were analyzed separately, and the traditional MVC pattern was improved based on AOP. A configuration file structure based on AOP and MVC structure was designed. Finally, the proposed method was compared and analyzed with the other three methods under the same database conditions through system testing. The results show that the proposed method achieves the minimum average response time (RTT) and memory occupancy rate (MU) under the same experimental conditions, and under large data volume, the response time is not more than 5 seconds, and the memory occupancy rate does not exceed 75%. Its performance meets user requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Dual Power Supply Fast-Switching Equipment Based on Fast Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of industrial society, the high-end manufacturing industry has put forward higher requirements for power quality. Voltage dips or power supply interruptions are causing huge problems for business production. For companies with dual power supplies, about half of the load stops working when one power supply fails. In this paper, a set of dual power supply fast-switching equipment is developed for this problem, which can realize the fast isolation of faulty power supply and the fast input of backup power supply, and improve the reliability of load power supply. The dual power supply fast-switching equipment includes fast circuit breakers and a fast-switching control device (FSCD). Among them, the fast circuit breaker adopts the principle of electromagnetic repulsion, for the 10 kV fast circuit breaker can realize opening within 1 ms and closing within 6~8 ms. The FSCD collects electrical signals and switching status signals and performs fast switching according to the control principle. In addition, a multilevel power fast-switching cooperative control method is proposed in this paper, which realizes the information interaction between upper and lower-level FSCD, as well as between FSCD and fast circuit breakers based on Hundred Gigabit Ethernet. This method achieves synchronized startup of upper and lower FSCD and improves the success rate of fast switching. A typical industrial distribution network simulation model is built to verify the advantages of the fast-switching cooperative control method. Finally, the effectiveness of the dual power supply fast-switching equipment is verified through a test.

articleTitle: Configuration and Operation Optimization in Microgrid Considering Source and Load Uncertainty (CICED 2024)
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Guided by the “carbon peak” and “carbon neutrality” policies, clean energy will rapidly develop. In microgrid systems (MGs) with renewable sources, the variability of wind and solar outputs combined with load uncertainty complicates the rational design of system capacity configuration and operational strategies. The paper addresses the uncertainty of source and load through scenario generation and reduction, constructing a two-layer optimization model for MG configuration and operation. The upper layer employs Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for configuration optimization, while the lower layer uses Genetic Algorithm (GA) for operational strategies. Finally, the reliability and economy of this dual-layer optimization model are confirmed through simulation studies on both islanded and grid-connected MG configurations and operational strategy. Furthermore, the paper further elucidates the impact of source and load uncertainty on the configuration and operational results of the MG.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Allocation and Capacity of Energy Storage to Improve the Three-Phase Unbalance in Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Three-phase unbalance occurs in the distribution network due to unbalanced loads, uneven power equipment parameters, system faults, and improper maintenance, integration of renewable generation, etc. Distributed Energy Storage System (DESS) is one of the effective means to solve this problem due to its flexible power regulation function. Through proper setting of DESS, the three-phase unbalance can be reduced. In this paper, a three-phase power flow model for unbalanced distribution systems is proposed considering the PV-type DG and energy storage device. And the zero-sequence voltage unbalance is defined to evaluate the system unbalance. A modified particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed to find the optimal allocation and capacity of energy storage devices connected to the distribution system. Case studies show that the three-phase unbalance of the distribution system can be effectively improved by the optimal allocation of energy storage devices.

articleTitle: Fault Ranging Method for Medium Voltage Distribution Lines Based on SSA Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To tackle the problem of accurate fault location in multi-branch distribution lines, a fault identification method is proposed on the foundation of optimized sparrow search algorithm. The method focuses on the optimal selection of variational modal decomposition parameters using the sparrow search algorithm, which solves the problem of deviation of distribution line fault ranging results due to the uncertainty of the variational modal decomposition parameters, and has higher localization accuracy and reliability compared with the traditional fault location algorithms.

articleTitle: Emergency Repair Path Planning of Power Distribution Station Under Flood Disaster
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Flood disasters may lead to faults in power distribution stations. When faults occur, it is necessary to plan repair paths after the disaster, so that the power distribution stations can return to normal working status as soon as possible. This paper takes the shortest total path of emergency repair vehicles as the objective function. It limits that each power distribution station can only be visited by one emergency repair vehicle, and all power distribution stations must be visited. Finally, all emergency repair vehicles return to the emergency repair center. The genetic algorithm and gray wolf algorithm are used respectively to plan the path. Finally, the optimal path is obtained and the performance difference between the two algorithms is compared. When the scale of the repair problem is relatively large, the genetic algorithm can be used preferentially, and when the scale of the repair problem is medium, the gray wolf algorithm can be used preferentially.

articleTitle: Influences of Oscillation Energy Propagation in Power Systems with high-Percentage Renewables
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The increasing integration of renewable energy into the power grid has heightened the impact of its volatility and unpredictability. Concurrently, renewable energy sources are progressively contributing to voltage/frequency support, while also being vulnerable to various grid disturbances. This complexity amplifies the dynamic behavior of the power system, posing a significant challenge to its stable operation. However, the propagation characteristics and attenuation mechanisms of oscillation energy in the power grid remain unclear. Therefore, this paper firstly constructs a mathematical model of oscillation energy in power systems based on the chain system and derives the dispersion relationship of different frequency disturbances. Secondly, the attenuation characteristics of oscillation energy are closely related to power flow direction and line resistance through the dispersion relation. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical derivation and related conclusions is verified based on numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Data Center Energy Consumption Simulation and Prediction from the Perspective of Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the Chinese data center industry has experienced rapid growth, yet it faces challenges of high energy consumption and low resource utilization. To achieve intelligent management, the digital twin technology has received widespread attention. This paper utilizes digital twin technology and leverages Unity3D to construct a simulation platform for the data center. This platform is capable of receiving temperature field information, displaying three-dimensional temperature cloud maps visually to evaluate the energy efficiency of data centers. Additionally, we design a deep neural network to predict the device energy consumption and calculate energy efficiency. Our research method helps management personnel gain comprehensive insights into the real-time status of data centers and make effective adjustments, thereby promoting the green and high-quality development of data centers.

articleTitle: Fault Type Identification Method of DC Loop Network Based on CEEMD-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the DC loop network system, this paper proposes a DC loop network fault type identification method based on CEEMD-SVM. The DC line current signal is collected as the original signal and decomposed by CEEMD. Using the combination of correlation coefficient and energy distribution, two most sensitive IMF components are selected from the IMFs components obtained by CEEMD decomposition. The statistical characteristics and frequency domain characteristics of the selected IMF components are calculated to form a feature matrix. Then the feature matrix is input into the first two-class SVM model for fault detection, and the detected fault data is input into the second multi-class SVM model for fault type identification. MATLAB simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Load Control Authentication Technology for New Power System Based on ECC Fusion Quantum Key
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid technology, load control techniques have also advanced swiftly. However, ensuring the security and confidentiality of load control systems, particularly achieving secure communication between the Power Load Management System (PLS) and the Load Control Terminal (LCT), poses a highly challenging issue. To address this, this paper proposes an anonymous identity authentication and re-authentication scheme based on quantum random numbers. This scheme ensures the security and privacy of identity authentication between PLS and LCT in various scenarios, significantly reducing the computational and communication overheads required for authentication by 66% compared to existing solutions. Finally, we employ BAN logic to formally verify the security of this scheme.

articleTitle: A Novel Load Transfer Method for Distribution Systems Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When a fault occurs in a radial distribution system, the lost load should be transferred to the non-fault branches for service restoration. However, current load transfer methods are difficult to develop the optimal load transfer scheme in a short time. This paper proposes a novel load transfer method for distribution systems based on the reinforcement learning algorithm. Firstly, the process of load transfer is analyzed and formulated as the Markov decision model. Secondly, the deep reinforcement learning is applied into the problem of load transfer. The interaction between the intelligent agent and the distribution system is modeled with the objective of maximizing the restored load. Key constraints such as voltage, current and radial topology are considered. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified based on the distribution system of an urban power grid.

articleTitle: Power IoT Comprehensive Perception Architecture Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power Internet of Things has the characteristics of comprehensive state perception, efficient information processing, convenient and flexible application, including four layers of perception layer, network layer, platform layer and application layer. The perception layer is the key level of the power Internet of Things, which is the data source and the foundation of the Internet of Things. This paper focuses on three different application scenarios of the operational perception, auxiliary perception and patrol perception of the power Internet of Things perception layer. It adopts wired private network, LoRa wireless private network and 5G wireless communication technology, adopts hierarchical and partitioned star network architecture, and relies on the advanced technology of total perception to achieve the effect of condition monitoring, live detection and automatic inspection. Improve O&M security, reliability, and lean management.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Based Distributed Cooperative Frequency Control of Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the intricate operational mechanisms of various renewable energy sources within existing microgrid systems, fluctuations in output or load power and frequency instability are prone to occur, this study proposes a collaborative frequency control strategy based on digital twin strategy with depth deterministic strategy gradient (DDPG). Firstly, the utilization of the DDPG algorithm in microgrid systems is analyzed, and the network parameters of the strategy are planned accordingly. Secondly, real-time data from the AC microgrid is collected through a sensor network. Finally, the DDPG algorithm model is trained to create a new intelligent algorithm engine for microgrid frequency control. Compared to simulations driven by the digital twin, the DDPG-based control strategy presented in this study enhances the control accuracy of the digital twin system for AC microgrids and accelerates convergence speed.

articleTitle: Distributed Power Grid Partition Collaborative Voltage Control Method Based on Deep Learning and Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed power grid partition collaborative power control method based on deep learning(DL) and federated learning(FL) to address issues such as strong voltage fluctuations and voltage exceeding limits in power grid systems containing distributed power sources. Firstly, based on the characteristics of distributed power grids, the features of DL models and federated control models are summarized, and their applications in the field of voltage control are analyzed;Then, based on this, a collaborative voltage control method was proposed, which combines the process characteristics of DL and FL to further improve the voltage control level and reduce network losses;Several voltage control methods were simulated and tested on a distributed power grid system. The simulation results showed that the collaborative voltage control method proposed in this paper had the smallest node voltage deviation and network loss in the distributed power grid system, with a reduction of 17.6% and 5.8%, respectively, improving the overall operating efficiency of the power grid.

articleTitle: Inversion of Soil Thermal Conductivity and Ampacity of the Buried High Voltage Power Cables
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Buried power cables are widely used because it has the advantages of a short construction cycle and an excellent heat dissipation ability. Different laying condition in the process of operations has an important impact on the temperature rise and ampacity of the power cable. In this paper.a multi-physics coupled field model of the electromagnetic field and the thermal field is first developed. In this respect, on the basis of burial laying, one takes into account the heat dissipation mode of the cable, heat dissipation path, characteristic parameters of the materials and other factors. The soil thermal conductivity is an important parameter to determine the accuracy of the cable's temperature field and ampacity. In this regard, a mathematical model for inversion of the soil thermal conductivity and cable ampacity is then proposed. The single-target immune clone selection algorithm(ICSA) is used to solve the corresponding inverse problem. The numerical results show that the inverse method is quite useful to the numerical calculation of the buried cables' ampacity and favorable to the ampacity's improvement.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation Method of Virtual Power Plant Considering Energy Storage Capacity Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the integration of distributed energy sources such as wind energy and photovoltaic into the power grid, the intermittency and uncertainty have a certain impact on the stability of the power system. In order to improve the consumption and absorption capacity of distributed energy, a two-layer planning model based on energy storage capacity configuration is proposed in the context of virtual power plants. The upper model establishes a model with the goal of the lowest total cost of the energy storage power plant, and the lower model establishes a model with the goal of the lowest total operating cost of the virtual power plant and the smallest waste of scenery. Then the improved particle swarm algorithm is used to solve the capacity configuration, charge and discharge of the energy storage power plant, and the operating state of the virtual power plant. Finally, the proposed model is verified by combining different scenarios. The results show that the proposed method can optimize the optimal configuration and charge and discharge strategy of energy storage power plants, improve the consumption capacity of renewable energy and the operating efficiency of virtual power plants.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method of Active Distribution Networks Based on Graph Attention V2 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper develops a fault location method for active distribution networks fault location method based on the graph attention v2 network (GATV2). The GATV2 introduces the concept of dynamic attention and improves the performance of the model by adjusting the order of operation of the network layer of the graph attention network (GAT) to achieve the calculation of the dynamic attention value. The efficacy of the GATV2-based fault location model of active distribution networks is validated through the construction of a fault scenario model for active distribution networks within the IEEE33 node network. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the positioning accuracy and generalization performance of the GATV2 model is superior to that of the traditional fault location model when performing traditional single-phase ground fault scenarios and fault scenarios where multiple fault types coexist.

articleTitle: Power Coordination Strategy for Flexible Interconnected Distribution Systems Containing Multiport Energy Routing Device
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the AC/DC distribution system with the PV and energy storage, the power coordination control strategy based on multiport energy routing device is proposed. The energy storage includes mobile energy storage vehicles and electric vehicles. Firstly, the multiport energy routing device is constructed from the AC/DC/AC cascade converter, and the typical operation modes of the system under energy storage voltage regulation are analyzed. Then, the power balance relationship and mode switching logic within the system under different operating modes are investigated based on the PV output and energy storage state. Subsequently, the load balancing control strategy considering normal and failure conditions is proposed to regulate power flows, ensuring consistent load rates across distribution areas. The power regulation command of the proposed strategy can enable system stability and load transfer, which improves the power supply reliability of the interconnected distribution system.

articleTitle: Net Load Forecasting Method for Distribution Substation Based on an Improved MHGSA Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the promotion and application of distributed photovoltaic power generation in the distribution substation, the net load of the distribution substation is affected by both the total electricity consumption load of users and the photovoltaic output. Considering various influencing factors such as photovoltaic power generation, meteorology, and non-working day user electricity consumption behavior, as well as the temporal characteristics of net load in distribution substation, this paper proposes a net load forecasting model for distribution substation based on an improved Multi-Head Gumbel-softmax Sparse self-Attention (MHGSA) mechanism. The model first decomposes the net load time series data through variational mode decomposition. Then the training dataset is formed by overlaying factors such as photovoltaic power generation and meteorology, and the MHGSA mechanism is introduced into a dual-layer LSTM model to establish a net load forecasting model. Experimental results have shown that the method proposed in this paper has high prediction accuracy and can achieve accurate prediction of net load in distribution substation.

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification Method for Substation Gateway Machine Measurement Points Based on RCD Files
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A simulation verification method for substation gateway machine measurement points based on RCD files is proposed to address the low efficiency and high error rate of traditional manual verification methods for substation measurement points. Firstly, a simulation system for substation gateway machine measurement points is designed, which replaces manual operation with simulated signals to improve verification efficiency. Then, the convolutional neural network (CNN) is improved and combined with random non-repeating extraction full detection technology to form a measurement point verification model. Finally, the validation model will be deployed in the virtual testing system to analyze the 104 protocol point table converted within the system and regulate the information of the issued point table, thereby completing the automatic validation of the RCD file. Based on the RCD file of a 220kV intelligent substation, experimental analysis is conducted on the proposed method, and the results shows that its verification accuracy and time are 96.28% and 4.61h, respectively, which can be well applied to the simulation of substation gateway machine measurement points.

Author Keywords: random and non-repeated extraction full inspection technology

articleTitle: Application Research of Edge Algorithms for Privacy Protection in Distribution Network Fault Diagnosis Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of smart grids, distribution network fault diagnosis systems play a crucial role in ensuring the stable operation of power systems. However, traditional centralized diagnostic methods face issues such as data privacy breaches and low computational efficiency. This paper proposes a novel method that applies privacy protection algorithms based on edge computing to distribution network fault diagnosis systems. By deploying privacy protection algorithms at edge nodes, the method achieves distributed fault diagnosis and local data processing, significantly improving computational efficiency and data security. Experimental results show that this method ensures high diagnostic accuracy while substantially reducing data transmission volume and the risk of privacy breaches. This research provides a new solution for the secure and efficient operation of smart grids.

articleTitle: Benefit Analysis of GenCo Participating in the Electricity-Carbon-Green Certificate Market under the TGC-CCER Mutual Conversion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing demands for a low-carbon power system, countries are considering the use of environmental policies, such as carbon markets and green certificate markets, in coordination with electricity markets to reduce carbon emissions. However, the Tradable Green Certificate (TGC) and China Certified Emission Reduction (CCER) for renewable energy power may lead to double incentives, which could undermine the recognition of the unique environmental value of electricity. Therefore, a fixed TGC-CCER mutual conversion mechanism is proposed in this paper, and subsequently a bilevel optimization model involving a generation company (GenCo) participating in the electricity-carbon-green certificate market is established, which includes thermal units and photovoltaic-energy storage system (PV-ESS) integrated systems. Furthermore, the benefit of the proposed model in promoting renewable energy integration and emissions reduction in the power system is validated using a modified IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Passive Multi-Function Optical Sensor Systems Based on Power-Over-Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric power cable-based energy and information co-transmission is an important topic. This paper investigates energy and information co-transmission through optical cables and develops a set of equipment based on electric power cable for such transmission. According to the research findings, the device meets all specified criteria after testing. Moreover, in the application scenario of online monitoring of transmission lines, utilizing the energy and information co-transmission technology of electric power cables enables detection of micro-meteorological conditions and images of overhead line pylons.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Digital Twin System for Substation Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The main and auxiliary equipment information of traditional substation is presented in a two-dimensional logic, with low degree of sharing, resulting in ineffective linkage between the main and auxiliary equipment, and the operation and maintenance mode is relatively lagging, making it difficult to meet the development needs of smart grid. Regarding the above-mentioned problems, A design scheme of digital twin system for substation based on BIM technology was proposed. The scheme uses the BIM model of substation and the real-time sensing data of monitoring system and auxiliary control system to build the mapping body of the realistic substation in the virtual space, namely the substation digital twin system, which makes the complex and abstract equipment operating information easier to display and more intuitive, and improves the digitalization and transparency of substation operation and maintenance management. It improves the panoramic real-time perception ability of operation and maintenance personnel on substation equipment and environment in a three-dimensional virtual environment. It can realize the functions of three-dimensional panoramic monitoring of substation, intelligent early warning, data statistical analysis, remote intelligent patrol, intelligent linkage between main and auxiliary systems, intelligent analysis, intelligent control and security control. The substation digital twin system has been widely used in the new 110kV and above smart substations in Shanghai power grid, which verified the effectiveness and advancement of the system.

articleTitle: Voltage Regulation Strategy for Medium and Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As distributed energy resources and power electronics technology undergo swift advancements, high-power equipment and nonlinear loads have been widely applied. It has greatly improved productivity but also led to multiple aspects of power quality concerns in distribution network, such as voltage deviation, harmonics, and three-phase imbalance. Control strategy with four-leg three-phase four-wire (TP-FW) parallel active power filter alongside static synchronous compensator is presented in this paper. The proposed strategy, along with the refined design methodology for key parameters, could effectively deal with power quality issues under conditions of undesirable grid voltage and asymmetric loads. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation results in MATLAB/Simulink, which could ensure the stability of the voltage in medium and low voltage distribution network and promote the improvement of power quality.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Interactive Regulation Framework Based on Hierarchical and Zonal Structure Supporting Large-scale New Adjustable Load Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent interactive regulation framework based on hierarchical and partitioned structure is proposed to support a new type of large-scale flexible load resource. Driven by the “Double Carbon” target, the construction of New Power Systems has been accelerated, and the proportion of electricity in terminal energy consumption has increased significantly. Firstly, this paper analyzes the influence of new loads such as electric vehicle and data center on the Operation Mechanism and balance mode of power system. Then, the paper discusses the current research situation of power grid hierarchical partition methods, and points out the shortcomings of existing methods. In this paper, a new intelligent interactive regulation framework is proposed, and the cluster cooperative and interactive regulation strategy of adjustable load resources is proposed. The feasibility of the proposed model is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Applications of Graph Computing and Graph Neural Networks in Power Systems: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increased integration of renewable energy sources and power electronic devices, the complexity and uncertainty of power system operations have risen significantly, leading to an evolution in power system computation. Graph computing and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offer innovative perspectives and solutions to these challenges. This paper explores the application of graph computing in the analysis of large-scale and complex networks in power systems, as well as the potential of graph neural networks in data-driven power grid operation analysis and decision making. The paper systematically reviews the fundamental theories and key technologies of graph computing and GNNs, along with their specific applications in power systems. These applications include, but are not limited to, load forecasting, state estimation, and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Adaptive Abnormal Condition Detection for Low-Voltage Distribution Network based on the Quantile Regression Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern power system, new energy continues to pour in, which not only brings optimization to the energy structure, but also increases the uncertainty of power grid operation. As an important guarantee link of power supply reliability, the timely detection of abnormal working conditions of the distribution network is very important. An adaptive abnormal condition detection method for low-voltage distribution network based on quantile regression gradient boosting decision tree model is proposed in this paper. Through the fitting of the current value, the corresponding dynamic threshold is generated according to the quantile principle and brought into the corresponding detection process. Under the condition of using fewer data sets, the detection of abnormal situations with small degree of current fluctuations can be realized. Using the actual data collected in Tianjin, China, the simulation experiment verifies that the method can achieve better detection results.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Grounding Fault Location of Distribution Network Based on Physical Information Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Tackling extensive data requirements and the complexity of mechanisms in data-driven fault location for distribution networks, the paper introduces an information-physics-based approach for single-phase grounding fault location in active distribution networks. Firstly, the virtual zero-sequence current injection state of each node is examined to clarify electrical support for physical information guidance.
